# Dual-Library and Books Supplementary Pilot Conclusions (10-13, US Eastern)

## Scope and Methods
Read-only access to Zotero PDF attachments and EndNote Phd.Data/PDF; production libraries were not touched, and other PDFs in Downloads were not included. Zotero sqlite was read-only from a WSL pre-copied replica, and EndNote .enl was unparsed. Continued using the previous round's SQLite FTS5 BM25 page index, incrementally indexed locally; a CJK trigram index was separately built for Chinese, and a limited fixed wind-engineering Chinese-English terminology table was attempted during querying. No new online services, Gemini, GPU/Colab (0 CU), or supercomputers were used; full text of books was never sent externally. New criteria were written before incremental retrieval evaluation, and old were not modified. The 6 newly added questions were all non-first physical pages of books, including 3 Chinese questions; the original 34 Chinese questions were also retested after the library expansion.

## Inventory
| Library | PDF Attachments | Extractable Text | Entirely Textless | Extraction Failure/Timeout | Index Newly Added Readable Physical Pages |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Zotero | 3164 | 3061 | 83 | 20 | 128,708 pages combined with EndNote |
| EndNote | 1527 | 1440 | 76 | 11 | 128,708 pages combined with Zotero |

The previous Zotero index excluding books and book chapters has been completed in this round, making a total of 4,501 attachments and 128,708 non-empty physical pages searchable; source PDF sizes are Zotero 16.53 GiB, EndNote 6.24 GiB. Candidate merge results based on normalized titles / usable DOIs yielded 3,845 clusters; EndNote lacks structured DOIs and has truncated filenames, and has not been verified as an accurate unique document count. In-library PDF attachments by Zotero parent itemType: book 73, bookSection 26, thesis 50, journalArticle 2870, other 145; not the same basis as the full-library itemType entry counts of 87/32/60. 1517/1527 EndNote items cannot be reliably classified solely by filename; its 9 "book" heuristic candidates contain false positives and cannot serve as the real count of books. First-page text heuristics classifying English / Chinese / mixed / unknown see details in . 159 entirely textless attachments total 10,553 physical pages, but this cannot be used to determine the proportion of scanned files, nor can OCR time be directly estimated; 31 extraction failures are counted separately. corrects two overly strong statements in the automated inventory report.

## Same-Question Retrieval (Top 5, PDF Physical Page ±1)
| Question Group / System | Page Correct | Document Correct | Notes |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Original English 34 questions, expanded library BM25 | 25/34 | 29/34 | All first-page questions; |
| Original English 34 questions, expanded library BGE-small-en hybrid | 27/34 | 29/34 | CPU reranking only on top 60 BM25 pages, not full-library vector index; |
| Added 6 book questions, expanded library BM25 | 1/6 | 1/6 | All internal book pages |
| Added 6 book questions, CJK trigram + limited terminology table | 1/6 | 2/6 | Poor retrieval when paraphrased; first exact long-string configuration was 2/6 pages, here is the revised trigram segmentation result |
| Original Chinese 34 questions, expanded library BM25 | 0/34 | 2/34 | Chinese questions on English papers |
| Original Chinese 34 questions, CJK trigram + limited terminology table | 0/34 | 0/34 | Regressed compared to BM25, cannot be called usable for cross-lingual retrieval |

Question-by-question top 5, answer keys, and page numbers see and ; improved script . Using specific Chinese keywords "微下击暴流 水平尺度 生命周期" (microburst horizontal scale life cycle) in CJK can return page 23 of the Chinese monograph PDF (already tested), but natural language paraphrased B04 only hit the document, missing the page; Chinese paraphrases of English papers cannot be resolved by Chinese character trigrams. The 6 added book questions are both small in number and carry question ambiguity, and cannot be extrapolated to overall accuracy; the original English first-page questions cannot prove real cross-page fact search. Duplicate PDFs between the two libraries are indexed separately by source key, which crowds top-5 slots; cross-library same-work merging has not yet entered retrieval result deduplication.

## Recommendations
Retain only the local full-text retrieval prototype, without connecting to formal or constructing a reusable wind engineering dataset based on this. Expanding the library is feasible (page, book, and Chinese text indices can all be built); but internal book pages at 1/6 and cross-lingual Chinese at 0/34 failed the quality gate. Next, if a decision is made to invest, first decode EndNote metadata / calibrate book types and cross-library duplicates before conducting multilingual retrieval and an independent cross-page question bank; OCR must sample scanned pages first. The 60-item manual verification gate for the original downburst extraction sample table is still uncompleted, and this supplement has not changed its "cannot be ingested" status.

items.text:
# Zotero + EndNote PDF Corpus Inventory (10-13, US Eastern)

Source libraries are read-only; Zotero metadata is taken from the local WSL replica library, and EndNote .enl was unparsed: titles are derived from filenames, so DOIs exist only in Zotero, and EndNote types/years and cross-library deduplication are conservative approximations. All document counts are based on actually visible PDF attachments, not equal to the total count of Zotero itemType entries.

| PDF Attachments (Pre-deduplication) | Unique Candidate Documents Merged with the Other Library* | Size | Extractable Text Attachments | Textless Attachments | Extraction Failures | English / Chinese / Mixed / Unknown** | book / bookSection / thesis / journalArticle / Other or Unclassified |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |
| 3164 | 2592 | 16.53 GiB | 3061 | 83 | 20 | 2959/2/95/108 | 73/26/50/2870/145 |
| 1527 | 1348 | 6.24 GiB | 1440 | 76 | 11 | 1402/0/35/90 | 9/0/1/0/1517 |

Merged candidate documents: 3845; cross-library same-title candidate clusters: 95; attachments pre-deduplication: 4691. Duplicate attachments within the same library, different editions / same-name collisions are not guaranteed to belong to the same work. EndNote filenames are truncated, and journal names and book titles cannot always be distinguished; therefore, accurate DOI deduplication or exact book/paper classification cannot be claimed.
*"Source unique candidate documents" represents internal deduplication within each library; the two rows cannot be added directly. Clusters are formed only by identical DOIs or normalized titles; EndNote lacks reliable DOIs, and same-name items with differentiating subtitles may be missed in merging.
**Sampling of the first 5 physical pages: CJK characters ≥20 classified as Chinese; English letters ≥100 with Chinese classified as mixed; fewer than 80 recognizable characters classified as unknown. This is not a full-text language classification. Filenames containing Chinese characters do not imply full-text Chinese either.
Total indexed non-empty physical pages: 128708. no_text refers to pages in an entire PDF where ≥40 characters cannot be extracted, which is not strictly equivalent to scanned files; failures/timeouts can even less be attributed to scans. The textless proportion is approx. 3.4%, serving as a lower bound for OCR workload; true scanned pages require page-by-page visual inspection, which has not yet been measured, so a reliable total labor hour estimate cannot be provided.
EndNote book markings are only a lower bound based on explicit filename hints; more books are mixed among unclassified items. EndNote documents with non-empty page count ≥150 can be listed as "long document candidates", but dissertations/theses will also be mixed in, so this is not used as an exact book count.
EndNote long document candidates (≥150 readable pages): 56.
Local index: PDF pages, without OCR. PDF physical pages and journal print pages are not used interchangeably.

## Round 2 Supplementary Notes (10-13, US Eastern; old inventory numbers unchanged)
Retrieval Round 2 continues to use the same index of 4,691 PDF attachments and 128,708 non-empty physical pages, without re-decoding EndNote .enl, without OCR, or adding source libraries; corrections in still apply. 3,845 is merely a candidate work cluster count merged by normalized titles / partial DOIs, not a verified unique document count across editions; 159 items with no indexable text in full text and 31 extraction failures cannot be converted into a scanned document proportion. All new Round 2 questions are on already indexed pages, but manual selection of clear facts means results do not represent a random full-corpus sample; deduplicating retrieval results by same-title-same-physical-page is also not equivalent to strict DOI-level cross-library deduplication. The proportion of Chinese books / Chinese questions applies only to the frozen question bank, not to the corpus distribution.

# Post-Hoc Quality Verdict on the Frozen Question Bank (Without Modifying SHA or Raw Results)

The question bank questions_round2.jsonl was frozen before retrieval, SHA-256: 4ec35a6695ad021116533fd3e1ef33f11999d716d6a32232c20fa58217a21cb0. Fixed at 30 questions; same-question scoring across all systems is detailed in retrieval_round2_rows.csv. After inspecting the physical pages of standard answers, the following three questions were found to have factual/attribution discrepancies and were symmetrically excluded across all systems, without modifying original questions or supplementing questions:

R17: The question stated that the buffeting factor tending toward 1 after 17–18% turbulence intensity was from the current twin tall-building experiment, whereas the original page was actually recounting external research by Taniike (1991) (PDF key T474JX49 p8). Classified as citation misattribution.

R24: The question stated approx. 10% as the "upper bound of phase lag" between motion and aerodynamic force; this value is actually the energy contribution of the first POD mode, and two-column text extraction strung non-uniform lag from the other column into the same sentence (END-96601aaef4ee6b2d p12). Classified as two-column text interleaving.

R30: The question asked about the upper bound of multichannel acquisition time delay, but the standard answer anchor was merely "up to 35 channels", which is not a time delay; numerical quantities on the page were broken apart by two-column interleaving, preventing correct fact localization based on it (END-93a00b9d52d359a7 p4). Classified as answer anchor error.

Therefore, "30 original questions" and "27 valid factual questions" are reported side by side, never reporting only the favorable one. Valid questions 27 < required ≥30, so the strict scale gate for the Round 2 question bank was not passed. One cannot add questions after seeing retrieval results to masquerade as the pre-frozen 30 questions. Sampling was conducted by manual selection of pages with clear facts after preliminary screening with a fixed random seed, rather than a strictly uniform random sample of pages/papers; the question bank does not represent the full-library user query distribution.

Further checking of the first two pages of the PDFs revealed that among the six questions selected with Zotero parent itemType=book, R03 is a government research report by Willoughby, and R04 is explicitly labeled Technical Report (2002); although labeled book, they cannot be counted as physical books. Physical books or bound guides comprise only four questions: R01, R02, R05, and R06; thus, the strict gate of "≥5 book questions" was also not passed. The original six supplementary book questions (questions_books_supplement.jsonl) belong to materials already run in Round 1 and cannot be mixed into Round 2 independent new questions to make up numbers. Both the original book metadata group of 6 questions and the physical book group of 4 questions retain their raw results, never altering group labels to hide issues.

items.text:
# Zotero Full-Text Retrieval × Downburst Profile Minimal Pilot (10-13, US Eastern)

## One-Sentence Judgment

Build only a full-text retrieval prototype, without turning this round's Gemini single-page extractions into a formal dataset. English first-page paper identification questions show clear gains; Chinese retrieval almost completely fails, and data extraction field attribution, definitions, and figure readings still require page-by-page manual handling. This round is a pilot trial, not publication-grade validation or formal tool approval.

## Scope and Actual Execution

- Zotero original library is read-only; first copy `zotero.sqlite` to . Exclude book/bookSection by attachment parent type, index ; local FTS5 Porter BM25, `pdftotext -layoutprocessed` table logs the cause of each failure.
- Retrieval prototype: , or . Outputs title, year, parent key, PDF physical page, and snippet. BGE-small-en-v1.5 encodes on CPU over the top 60 pages recalled by BM25 across the full library and reranks via RRF; it is not an independent full-library vector ANN index. retains standalone full-page vector construction code, but only has a few incomplete test shards, not participating in reported scoring; it must not be claimed that a full-library vector index has been built.
- Question bank: Chinese 34 questions, question-by-question manual English paraphrases 34 questions (frozen before retrieval). 11 papers have cards in the wiki directory, 23 do not; spanning downbursts, tall building wind pressure, wind spectra, CFD, structural response. English question bank SHA256 `8dc91c50996c4c1367644f12df5930f1d040e22ad9de60cf6a78ef9a95323d39`, Chinese `40a22641e84df724fef5272f15eca7ba8281ec2ce25d23685555610724a563b1`. Questions are mostly paraphrases of titles/abstracts, and standard answers are all PDF physical page 1; easier than real cross-page fact QA, and metrics can only be interpreted as paper discovery and first-page localization. Journal print pages and physical pages must not be used interchangeably.

## Retrieval Measurements After Full-Library Indexing Completion (34 Questions, Top 5 Paper-Pages)

| Identical English Question Bank | Correct Paper and PDF Page ±1 | Paper Hit Only | Basis |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| BM25 | 25/34=73.5% | 29/34=85.3% | |
| BM25→CPU BGE-small hybrid reranking | 27/34=79.4% | 30/34=88.2% | |
| Existing | Unjudgeable: search output has no verifiable PDF physical page | 14/34=41.2% | |

On the original Chinese question bank (untranslated), both BM25 and only hit papers for 2/34, with BM25 exact page at 0/34. The English conversion is another pre-frozen test input and cannot be treated as Chinese questions reaching English performance as well. Raw top-5 lists for each question are in , . Preregistered English primary metric ≥70%, hybrid outperforming BM25, and index coverage ≥90% were all met; but first-page anchoring introduces an easy-question bias, and the Chinese applicability gate was not passed. page numbers must not be treated as PDF page numbers just because cards occasionally contain journal page numbers.

## Downburst Profile Experiment and Verification

- Exploratory Round 1 had 34 single-page texts; candidate selection was too loose, and all 34 were returned. Round 2 selected 36 papers from PDF pages containing profile figure captions (the labeled 12 CFD, 14 wind tunnel, 10 other are merely title heuristics, and cannot serve as verified source types), plus one field measurement paper: Romanic (2021) Cabauw 213m tower, PDF physical page 17, Fig. 16.
- Round 2, 36 papers: `z_max` has 11 non-empty entries, each row detailing PDF path, physical page, verifier, and rationale. Round 1 separately verified 10 items, 8 directly correct, 2 errors.
- Because semantic value-by-value manual verification was not performed on at least 60 items (only 97 items were automatically compared literally), there were no paper-by-paper timing records, and only one selected page was analyzed without full-text ground truth, the planned per-field overall accuracy, omission rate, and average manual verification time per paper are all **unevaluated**; the aforementioned non-random 12 items must not be used to compute overall accuracy. All CSVs are unaccepted sample tables and cannot be used as reusable datasets. Readings off figures were completely unread; no "figure reading" values may be assigned. Typical errors: other papers' cited values misattributed to the present study (`SAI7PQLC` p2), maximum velocity mismatched to different radial positions on the same page (`KN57R2JT` p24), treating assumed parameter sweep ranges as measured peak heights (`WZN3ETI3` p4), treating non-dimensional velocity as absolute Umax (`EFT4W6FE` p3). Details in and two verification CSVs.

## Judgment Table

| Stage | Feasible | Quality | Cost | Issues |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PDF by page + BM25 | Yes, 3065 attachments attempted | English first-page questions 25/34 exact page | Local CPU; indexing approx. tens of minutes; 0 CU | Missing OCR, 12 errors/timeouts, Chinese queries almost completely ineffective |
| CPU small dense vector hybrid reranking | Yes, reranking top 60 BM25 pages is operational | English first-page questions 27/34 exact page, +2 questions | Local BGE-small, 0 CU | Not independent full-page vector recall; cannot replace Chinese query handling |
| Comparison | Yes | English paper hit 14/34, page numbers unjudgeable | Existing service | Retrieval targets are cards, not full PDFs |
| Single-page Gemini data extraction | Can produce sample tables, cannot be directly ingested | Manual 12 items: only 5 directly correct, 6 with reservations, 1 error; 97 items checked literally, failing to meet 60-item manual verification | 71 subscription calls, 0 CU; manual verification time not recorded | Missing figure readings, field definitions and sources confused, omission rate unknown |

## Plan for Integration with (Platform Unmodified)

Maintain the Zotero PDF page index as an independent read-only service, exposing `search(query, top_k)` returning parent key, attachment key, PDF physical page, title/year, snippet, and index timestamp; only aggregates results and maps parent keys to existing cards. Card journal page numbers and PDF physical pages serve as two distinct fields and must never be swapped; pages without OCR are marked as missing. Chinese queries must explicitly undergo query translation or switch to multilingual dense vectors with re-preregistered tests containing cross-page facts before considering formal integration. Synchronization relies on read-only snapshots of the replicated Zotero library and attachment mtime, without touching the production library; integration remains the responsibility of the platform.

## Round 2 Supplement (10-13, US Eastern)
For new evidence and limitations regarding dual-library cross-page facts, books/Chinese, deduplicated retrieval, and extraction verification, see and in the same directory. Round 1 criteria and results remain preserved as above; follow-up results from the corrected figure-reading delegation to in Round 2 are only appended, without altering old numbers.

Recommendation: Retrieval only, do not initiate wind engineering dataset construction. Running English page-by-page retrieval standalone is valuable, but specialized validation must still be added for Chinese users and real cross-page QA; this round's data extraction did not pass the preregistered verification scale. Data source is Liang Hu's local Zotero PDFs; external software/model sources are in . No full text of any paper was sent externally.

items.title: Literature library round 2: cross-page search across both libraries and profile verification (10-13, US Eastern)
items.text:
# Literature Corpus Round 2: Dual-Library Cross-Page Retrieval and Profile Verification (10-13, US Eastern)

Same dual-library index, Zotero/EndNote original libraries are read-only; 4,691 PDFs, 128,708 non-empty physical pages. Original has appended Round 2 supplementary notes; corrections regarding the unreliability of EndNote book counts and scanned proportions see .

## Frozen Question Bank and Quality Verdict
 Frozen SHA-256 prior to retrieval.

## Results of Top 5 Deduplicated by "Normalized Title + PDF Physical Page"
| Question Group | BM25 Correct Paper + Page ±1 | Chinese trigram + Terminology Table | CPU Small Dense Vector Local Reranking | rc-kb Verifiable Paper Hits* |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Original English first-page 34 questions recomputed | 25/34 | 25/34 | BGE-small-en 29/34 | Original round 14/34, physical page unjudgeable |
| New cross-page 30 original questions (incl. 3 bad questions) | 12/30 | 17/30 | Multilingual MiniLM 14/30 | 1/30, physical page unjudgeable |
| Valid cross-page 27 questions (symmetrically excluded) | 9/27 | 14/27 | Multilingual MiniLM 12/27 | 1/27, physical page unjudgeable |
| book metadata group 6 questions (two are actually reports) | 4/6 | 4/6 | 4/6 | 0/6 |
| Physical books/guides 4 questions (descriptive) | 2/4 | 2/4 | 3/4 | Not evaluated separately |
| Chinese original papers 5 questions | 0/5 | 5/5 | 4/5 | 0/5 |
| Chinese questions on English 5 questions | 0/5 | 0/5 | 0/5 | 0/5 |

For the 5 Chinese questions on English, human manual translation of questions into English only was additionally conducted without sending literature: English translated questions BM25 3/5, with multilingual model reranking on its top 100 recalled pages 2/5. Models `paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2`, reranked on CPU only over BM25/Chinese terminology candidates, not independent full-library vector recall. Merging by same title and same physical page across attachments may cause false merges across different editions, or missed merges due to alternate spellings. * Comparison conservatively identified based on wiki card paths containing standard source keys; variant keys on cards were missed, so 1/27 is merely a verifiable lower bound, not representing full recall; card line numbers cannot be treated as PDF physical pages. Question-by-question raw , scoring , grouping , post-hoc symmetric exclusions. Dual-library deduplication CLI has already run Chinese questions and output keys / physical pages / snippets; unmodified.

## Profile Extraction Re-Verification
Among the original 97 non-empty fields in v2, an AI assistant read their original PDF physical pages entry by entry, re-verifying 78 items: 45 supported by same-page text (unconfirmed figure by figure), 27 requiring reservations on definition/operating condition, 6 errors. Not independent human verification, non-random sample, 45/78 is not a formal accuracy rate. Field distribution: z_max 1 directly supported / 8 with reservations / 1 error (10 total), U_max 1/3/0 (4), r/D 1/5/0 (6), normalization 9/5/0 (14), source_type 17/0/2 (19), rest see . With no human verifiers and no per-paper human timing, the planned per-field true accuracy and average manual verification time are both unevaluated. 8 full PDF texts underwent read-only candidate keyword scanning (135 pages, 805 candidates), not a page-by-page manual read-through, so omission rate is unevaluated.

Among the 8 sample table figure number pages originally extracted, for 5 papers the target figure was only mentioned in the text of that page, while the actual figure was on other physical pages. All corrected to the 8 single pages of ; only these single pages were sent to the Gemini worker. confirmed wrong pages in the first round; corrected figure page results from have returned. Local AI previously did rough reading, comparing paper by paper and condition by condition; and re-visually inspected 8 actual pages: 5 papers matched the rough reading range under the same condition, 1 paper matched only model parameter semantics, 1 paper's figure was too dense for quantitative per-radial evaluation, 1 paper could only be partially compared. These are all estimated reading consistency between AI and AI, not accuracy or error distribution against independent human figure-reading ground truth; per-curve figure reading errors and reliable completion rates for empty fields remain unevaluated. 6X6ZP3YD p8 Fig.15b 60° CFD approx. 25–30mm, 5.9–6.0m/s, is merely figure reading; 25–100m in WZN3ETI3 p4 is a model parameter sweep, not four observations. Error correction gates: 36XAQH9L workstation Fig. 15 does not provide R/D=1.2 (it belongs to Fig. 20 context); NXSSET4J p12 Fig. 11 α=0°, original text 0.099m belongs to α=180°, must not be mismatched; 8IC5IFK5 p7 seven radial points are crowded, cannot give precise per-radial peak heights; GBK98YNH p5 main vortex is an ensemble average of local peaks across heights rather than a simultaneous profile. Normalized peak velocity equal to 1 is a definition and must not be treated as absolute Umax; r/D cannot be conflated with planar jet x/b. These figure-read values have not been incorporated into the formal sample table.

## Judgment
Local retrieval is feasible, Chinese original papers at 5/5 show promise; however, valid cross-page questions and physical book questions fall short of preset numbers, Chinese questions on English are 0/5, and physical internal book pages are 2–3/4, so the formal full-text tool cannot yet be released. Data extraction has obvious problems with variable definitions, figure page localization, external cited values, and condition pairing, lacking human verification and ground truth read-through, so a formal dataset cannot be built. Recommended to select "retrieval only": preserve the local independent prototype, clean up frozen question banks, verify book authenticity, implement translation retrieval, and then evaluate formal integration. No Colab/HPC used (0 CU), no full PDF sent externally; links for the new multilingual model have been added. Gemini corrected figure page comparisons have been appended, without altering frozen questions and old retrieval results.

items.text:
# Literature Library: Retrieval Only, Profile Extraction Shelved; Retrieval Plan Handed Over to Platform (10-13 20:55)

- What was done: Adopted the ideas Round 2 recommendation of "retrieval only". Wrote an integration plan for the retrieval part and handed it over to Platform Lead, changed the project page status to "Pending promotion" (form factor: platform tool); downburst profile data extraction shelved. Round 3 will not be dispatched.
- Why: The gains from retrieval are already clear enough—about half of non-first-page factual questions reach page precision in top 5, compared to 1/27 at paper level; 5/5 for original Chinese, 3/5 for Chinese asking about English after translating questions, with a clear improvement path (routing by language, fixing two-column cross-talk, cross-library deduplication, full-library multilingual vectors); these belong to engineering implementation, which is more appropriate for the platform to do. Extraction: 6 errors out of 78 values, 27 require specified operating conditions, figure page localization wrong in 5/8 papers, core values are all on figures, automation saves limited effort.
- Did not meet expectations: In Round 2, valid questions 27 < 30, physical book questions 4 < 5 (thresholds I added in Round 2, not set by Liang Hu; the ≥30 questions required by Liang Hu's task brief was already met in Round 1). One manual verification item was replaced by AI review per this track's rules, not human ground truth; extraction accuracy is therefore only taken as a qualitative judgment of "unsuitable for ingestion into library".
- Basis: This track's data , ; Lead spot-checked standard answers for R01/R07/R13/R21/R27 and two extracted values, 6X6ZP3YD and GBK98YNH. No literature basis, based on data from this track. Not submitted for review: falls under tool feasibility judgment, not a scientific conclusion.
- Cost of being wrong: If Liang Hu wants the profile dataset, restarting requires expert hours checking paper by paper; if the platform does not take it over, the prototype can still be used locally on Workstation.

items.title: Delivery of OCR for local scanned PDFs (platform 0034, phase 2)
items.text:
# Local Scanned PDF OCR Delivery (Platform 0034 Phase II)

Time: 10-13 22:00–22:35 (ET). Read only the original PDFs from the two libraries; did not modify , the original question bank, or original retrieval scripts; did not call external services, Colab, or supercomputers (0 CU). Used local Poppler `pdftoppm` (longest side 2100 px) + Tesseract 4.1.1 `engchi_sim+eng`, writing plain text by PDF physical page without rewriting source PDFs. Source list: this track.

## Scale and Deduplication

- Input 159 attachments (Zotero 83, EndNote 76), totaling 10,553 PDF physical pages. After file-by-file SHA-256 byte deduplication: 80 items, 5,749 pages (79 duplicate attachments, 4,804 duplicate pages); further confirmed that two different-byte PDFs of *Introduction to Tropical Cyclone Dynamics* (327 pages each) had **completely identical text page by page (327/327)** under the same OCR parameters, so the index list delivered to the platform was folded by one more item: **79 items, 5,422 physical pages**. Folding was applied only to the delivery list; original OCR output is retained, and all 159 attachment keys are in the `aliases` of the list. This method cannot prove that other different scanned versions never duplicate.
- Final list by original source attribution: Zotero 75 items, EndNote 4 items; preliminary assessment based on evident Chinese characters in OCR and titles classified 2 items / 337 pages as Chinese literature, and 77 items / 5,085 pages as English, etc. English author names containing the Chinese "和" are not counted as Chinese literature; language identification is only a rough classification, not manual confirmation paper by paper.
- Among the 5,422 delivered pages, 5,407 pages have OCR text and 15 pages are blank; program failures: 0 pages. In thumbnail pixel percentage inspection, 13 of the blank pages were nearly completely white, and the other 2 dark images still had no text after inversion and re-OCR; one cannot conclude from this that these two pages have no important figures or tables. Running `pdftotext` on full text of source PDFs, there were no native text pages with ≥100 characters among the 80 items, thus no misclassified extractable text-layer PDFs were found in this batch; this does not prove that every page definitely has readable text.
- Plain text is approximately 10,423,317 bytes (counted from first-time OCR page files), delivery page list ; each page file is . Each line of the list has page number, file path, original PDF, SHA-256, source, and all attachment keys. Details , source file hash mapping , native text verification . The platform should use for ingestion; do not re-ingest non-deduplicated .

## Three-Item Pilot and Cost

Ran test runs on 3 pages each of the Chinese *Introduction to Tropical Cyclone Dynamics*, English Wilcox *Turbulence Modeling for CFD*, and Rotunno–Emanuel paper. 9 pages totaled 26.44 seconds; average 2.94 seconds/page, estimated at about 4.43 hours for a single process based on the folded 5,422 pages. In practice, parallelized in batches across 3→10 threads, including mid-course thread count changes and separate recognition of the Chinese duplicate copy, completing from 22:00 to approximately 22:35; the main batch recorded average per-page OCR+rendering of 2.35 seconds, median 2.18 seconds (parallel task time is not wall-clock divided by page count). Full volume was projected not to exceed 12 hours, with no need for Colab or external computing. Single Chinese pages typically took ~3–7 seconds, English body text typically ~1–4 seconds. Page-by-page elapsed time records , ; retry of the Chinese duplicate copy with different bytes is located at , without overwriting old output.

## Quality Check and Limitations

Read 20 pages of OCR text locally, recorded in (two pages each from 10 files, retaining short excerpts). Signs of proper noun, word segmentation, or number errors were visible on 8 pages, evident distortion risks in formulas/symbols on 8 pages, and signs of OCR errors in table of contents/headers on 4 pages; e.g., garbled text appeared near city names on p8 of the Chinese book, and formula variables and subscripts were distorted in the English papers. The text is sufficient for initial attempts at keyword recall, but cannot be directly cited for formulas or numerical values.

**Important unmet item: These 20 pages are manual text spot-checks of the OCR output, not word-by-word manual proofreading against PDF images.** This execution environment cannot provide reliable visual word-by-word proofreading for me without exfiltrating copyrighted page images; per confidentiality boundaries, no image pages were sent to external vision services. Therefore, character/word error rates, accuracy of Chinese proper nouns, and English formula accuracy for the 20 pages relative to the original pages are all **unevaluated**; the above classifications must not be treated as recognition accuracy. Before entering formal retrieval, it is recommended to manually check 20 pages via a local visual interface and mark errors page by page; citations will still return original PDF physical pages for manual verification.

Delivery acceptance is "page-level text mappable by original attachment key", not verified OCR precision or cross-page retrieval hit rate. Old files from Phase I of 0034, both and , were not touched. This report is a new file.

# Literature Library Full-Text Search Promoted to Platform Tool (10-14 10:10)

- What was done: Confirmed that Phase 1 acceptance of platform ticket 0034 passed, updated the project page status to "Promoted", scored the English factual group on the 11 valid questions, and arranged for Phase 3 Chinese/book validation to be run in-house using blind test questions authored by the Lab.
- Why: All five groups in Phase 1 met or exceeded the prototype (homepage 29/34, English factual 6/11 vs prototype 5/11, Chinese original 5/5, books 5/6, Chinese-to-English queries 3/5), and Phase 2 round 2 scored 22/27 on the 27 valid questions, exceeding the target of 20. Keeping the questions and answer keys inside the Lab prevents tuning parameters to the test set. Scoring note: `criteria.md` specifies that invalid questions are excluded from scoring; my earlier threshold note of "≥8/14" mistakenly labeled the raw 14-question prototype denominator as the valid-question denominator and is corrected to 11 questions.
- Basis: In-line data and platform acceptance exports; Lead verified SHA prefixes and R13–R16. No literature basis; based on in-line data. Not sent for peer review: this is tool acceptance rather than a scientific claim, and what is being created is a platform tool rather than a research project, executed under the brief's authorization to "write the specification and hand over to the Platform Lead".
- Cost if wrong: If the Phase 3 blind test exposes noticeable weakness in Chinese/book retrieval, the platform will need one more iteration; page numbers already cited by users are unaffected (results always return original PDF page numbers, and original pages are verified prior to citation).

items.title: Phase 3 blind test: `pages` in Chinese and English, books and scanned books (10-14 10:04, US Eastern)
items.text:
# Phase III Blind Test:  pages Chinese and English, Books and Scanned Books (10-14 10:04, ET)

This file and `questions_blind.jsonlresults.jsonl are both read-only; prototype retrieval was not called. The 30 questions were frozen before running scores; the SHA-256 of is `d80069db26f2bc53914f58d73556ef283d216ffd513a71ea3aac5c1bf10bd83b` (see `freeze.sha256`); 10 questions for original Chinese, 10 questions for Chinese asking about English, 10 non-first-page questions for physical books, with the last group including 3 OCR scanned book page questions: Wilcox, Dahlquist, and *Introduction to Tropical Cyclone Dynamics*. Each question points to physical page 3 or later of the PDF; titles and abstracts cannot serve as answers. For each question, only the question text was sent to ` pages "question" -n 5`; question bank answers and book page source texts were not sent to the service.  automatically translates Chinese questions; this service's own documentation states that it only transmits question text externally.

## Criteria and Verification

Continuing to use `criteria.mdpdftotext -f N -l N` to reread source PDFs: 26 short anchors matched verbatim; R3-18 did not match verbatim due to different symbolic hyphenation notation, but the original page indeed has the four corners `0°, 15°, 30° and 45°`, see . The 3 OCR questions were locally re-rendered from the specified PDF physical pages and recognized a second time with independent `tesseract --psm 6`: all three answer anchors were reproduced (Wilcox "Vortex stretching", Dahlquist "first quadrant", Chinese book "1672mm"). However, independent verbatim proofreading could not be performed by visually inspecting original scanned pages, particularly with OCR typos in Chinese place names; numerical ground truth on scanned pages should still be reviewed by someone able to visually inspect PDF images. Agreement between two OCR runs cannot be called human image ground truth.

## Frozen Scoring (One Formal Call per Question, Scores Not Modified by Diagnostic Queries)

| Question Group | Question Count | Top 5 Correct Work | Top 5 Correct Work and Physical Page ±1 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Original Chinese, Chinese questions | 10 | 10 | 9 |
| Chinese asking about English papers | 10 | 9 | 8 |
| Physical books native text | 7 | 4 | 4 |
| Physical scanned books OCR pages | 3 | 2 | 0 |
| Total | 30 | 25/30 (83.3%) | 21/30 (70.0%) |

Raw question-by-question output is in (including questions and as-is responses), verdict is in , grouping table is in . Automated scoring was originally 19/30; the original EndNote *Review of Typhoon Wind Field Models* and the same-named PDF in Zotero with English metadata had identical byte SHA-256, and physical pages 7/9 in Zotero directly hit R3-09/10 respectively; after restoring the two cross-library same-work hits, it became 21/30. Same-title different-edition copies were not used to impersonate the same page.

## Incorrect Questions and Diagnostics (All Retained as Formal Failures)

- Page errors in 4 questions: R3-01, 17, 29, 30. For the latter two questions, the OCR target pages have text, but only returned the book's first page or adjacent opening pages, not confirmed OCR recognition errors.
- Unretrieved in 5 questions: R3-14, 21, 23, 24, 28. Three native book questions did not enter the top five. Under the frozen Chinese query, R3-14 did not make the list, but an additional explicit English query could locate page 8 of the same work in Zotero; under the frozen query, R3-28 did not make the list, but an additional explicit English query could locate Wilcox page 30 (see ). These are merely diagnostics of the retrieval/translation chain and cannot replace formal scores; other unretrieved cases cannot yet be attributed to translation.
- Causal count of OCR misreads: 0 confirmed items, but this does not imply the OCR misread rate is zero; source pages of the Chinese scanned book were not visually verified for ground truth. In particular, the OCR Chinese book was attached as "Some remarks concerning the gradient-wind equation" (1949) in the output, while the actual PDF path was *Introduction to Tropical Cyclone Dynamics*: this is a mismatch of source metadata / work identification, and cannot be cited as a book under that incorrect title. The Dahlquist scanned book also only returned the first page rather than the factual page.

This is a small, non-random sample self-selected by the research team with multiple questions per work; it cannot be extrapolated to full-library retrieval accuracy, nor can it be considered to have passed the initial prototype gate just because it hit exactly 70%. 0/3 on the 3 OCR book questions is not yet sufficient to call Phase III "citable book pages" reliable. No Colab / HPC / external transmission of copyrighted book full text, 0 CU; did not modify or the Phase I frozen index.

Recommendations: Retain pages local retrieval for manual review; formal scientific citations, especially scanned book pages, must open the original PDF to verify pages and OCR numbers. Platform Phase III should prioritize checking long-book target page ranking, Chinese query translation, and mismatched work metadata for OCR attachments; report only aggregated phenomena, do not hand over blind questions and answers to the platform. Decision criterion: Retrieval only; do not yet announce that formal tools or datasets have passed acceptance.

# Desktop Drive I Literature and Books: Read-Only Inventory

Scope limited to and 19 + ionice idle, read via existing SSH ControlMaster. No PDFs copied/ingested into the library, neither of the two libraries nor the frozen index was touched; 0 CU. Statistical unit is file-byte consistency, which does not equal deduplication by academic work DOI/title.

## PDF Count, Size, Deduplication

File name suffix .pdf totaled 14,578; among them, 453 `._*.pdf` files are AppleDouble sidecar files, not counted as PDFs; another 132 attachments (70 unique byte files) could not be opened in pdfinfo: spot checks of file headers revealed PDF signatures, all zeros, HTML, etc., which cannot be treated as "scans". Readable PDF attachments: 13,993 items; the net additions and page counts below are **strictly for readable PDFs**, representing a lower bound on the total volume; the 132 items require separate diagnosis.

| Valid PDF Attachments | Size GiB | Intra-directory SHA-256 Unique Files | Intra-directory Duplicates |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 12933 | 13.40 | 11859 | 1074 |
| 1060 | 7.11 | 847 | 213 |

Unique files with identical bytes between the two directories: 156 items; 12,550 items after merging. ## Ingestion Plans (Neither Executed in This Round)

A: Recommended: do not copy PDFs. Extract text page by page in read-only mode on the desktop, transferring incremental text and an auditable manifest to Workstation's (not Drive C); retrieval results retain the desktop's original paths and physical pages; textless pages are OCRed locally on the desktop or streamed page-by-page via SSH, immediately deleting temporary pages. Original PDFs permanently reside on Drive I; index space depends on text density / SQLite inverted index, initially estimated at several GiB, requiring small-sample empirical testing first. A single metadata + text read scans approximately 15.87 GiB of unique PDFs (an index cannot be generated out of thin air without reading PDFs); actual time is determined by Tailscale / Drive I read speed and OCR, with no transfer benchmark performed. Without sharing Drive I paths, directly opening source documents from Workstation requires remaining connected to the desktop.
B: Copy the entire batch to Workstation's local WSL disk; valid PDFs across the two directories as-is total 20.51 GiB, or 15.87 GiB after removing byte duplicates and keeping only net new PDFs; if the counterpart requires the original identical directory hierarchy, the full volume is still needed. Adding index / OCR derived files adds at least several GiB; theoretical transmission lower bound = file bytes / actual SSH throughput (e.g., at 20 MiB/s, deduplicated net volume takes 13.5 minutes, full volume takes 17.5 minutes; this is merely a rate assumption, not a speed test; massive numbers of small files / WSL I/O may be much slower). Does not depend on the desktop being online, but increases copy maintenance and storage risks. Current available space is subject to `df` on the day of execution; any copy exceeding 5 GB must first be submitted to Liang Hu to designate a destination; no copying in this round.

Boundaries: This is only byte deduplication and does not eliminate different versions with the same DOI; scan estimation is based on only a two-page sample; original book texts were not transmitted externally; no remote software was installed; source-side .mat/.dat and loose PDFs in Downloads were not scanned. # Desktop Drive I Literature: No PDF Copying, Phased Text Extraction for Ingestion (10-14 11:30)

- What was done: Following inventory, dispatched Phase 1 of ideas according to Plan A—only extract pages with text layers into text onto Workstation ( left on desktop, retrieval results point to desktop's original paths; Workstation addition capped at 4 GB, stop immediately if Drive C remaining falls below 40 GB. OCR (approx. 127k pages), .pdg, and .djvu are placed in Phase 2, priorities to be determined after empirical measurements of volume and speed in Phase 1.
- Why: Net additions are ~12.5k items / 420k pages; copying the full batch of PDFs would take ~16–21 GB; however, Workstation's WSL disk is actually a vhdx on Drive C, which has only 47 GB left (below the 100 GB guideline threshold). Copying PDFs is infeasible, whereas extracting text takes only a few GB.
- Correction: My prior statement to Liang Hu that "WSL disk still has ~700 GB" was wrong—that was the nominal capacity of the virtual disk, while real space is constrained by Drive C.
- Basis: This track's data; Lead verified ext4.vhdx location and size on 10-14. No literature basis.
- Cost of being wrong: Phase 1 is read-only and can be stopped at any time; if text volume exceeds expectations, it stops at a small sample and will not blow up Drive C.

In particular, formulas, plot axes, code, and numerical values cannot be directly taken as scientific ground truth; citations must refer back to physical pages of the original desktop PDFs for visual verification. Because copyrighted page images were not sent out and no word-by-word visual proofreading against original images was performed, the actual misrecognition rate was not evaluated.

## Limitations and Handover

This round of OCR only progressed up to Book/中文; the remaining 105,338 pages must not continue running on the Workstation, and are to be handled according to the new location and space strategy designated by the Lead. The "10 threads 8–9 hours" in the old report was a parallel estimation error; the total throughput of 6 workers this time was approximately 1.05 pages/sec, but the density of scanned books varies significantly, so margin cannot be guaranteed based on a single speed. Format feasibility diagnosis has only been performed for `.djvu.pdg`, without full conversion. Please verify the gzip/SQLite read methods before platform ingestion; retrieval results must return original PDF paths and physical pages.

# Desktop DjVu / Chaoxing PDG to Text: Phase Final Version

10-15 14:25 EDT. Via the existing desktop SSH multiplexed connection; source books read-only, no book pages or full text sent out, 0 CU. No sudo used: tools like djvused, ddjvu, Tesseract, etc., were only unpacked on the desktop; DjVu extracted text layer page by physical page, blank text pages OCR'd locally on this machine; PDG decoded with local pdg-converter and then OCR'd locally on this machine. The two OCR paths total no more than 2 threads. The DjVu page numbers in the old version `djvu_pdg.sqlite` were once misaligned and are explicitly excluded; the final version only merges `djvu_only.sqlite`, the 11 PDG books in `djvu_pdg_v2.sqlite`, and `melenk_recovery.sqlite`.

Among the 62 byte-independent DjVu files, 61 books safely mapped 28,391 pages; Melenk's "Finite Element Methods for Singular Perturbations" has 283 pages in total, with 282 pages recovered, and page 201 encountered `Unexpected End Of File`. In total, DjVu should have 28,674 pages, of which 28,673 pages have been ingested, with 28,460 pages having text, 213 pages without text, and 1 page failed. The 11 sets of PDG have a total of 3,163 ordered page slots: 2,692 pages were successfully decoded and ingested into the database, with 2,680 pages having text and 12 pages without text; another 471 pages failed, categorized as outer 0x38 transformation 398, additional layers 72, and unsupported JPEG 1. Erroneous page slots and ingested page slots do not intersect. The "physical page" of PDG is the sequential index of the page files in the directory, not equivalent to the printed page numbers in the book.

The final version merges 73 document keys and 31,365 safely mapped page slots; 31,140 pages have text, 225 pages without text, and another 472 failed page slots are not in the database. items.text:
# OCR Phase 3 Post-Restart Continuation: Integrity Gate Failed

Time: 10-16 02:22 (EDT).

The existing ControlMaster socket check on the desktop passed; the root drive is mounted read-write (`rw`). Found continuation process PID 22492 already started at 10-16 00:56 targeting the working copy. No duplicate process was launched. The log recorded `START 1718 already 103620 workers 6 DONE 1718 errors 0 empty 30 wall_s 4746.2`, and the process had already exited.

However, during the final acceptance query, a read-only `select count(*)` raised `sqlite3.DatabaseError: database disk image is malformed`. A subsequent read-only `PRAGMA integrity_check(1)` returned `*** in database main ***; Page 62028: btreeInitPage returns error code 11`. Consequently, **the 105,338-page result cannot be certified as valid**; no final `wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` was executed, no copy was made to the final target (the target file does not exist), and no repair or rerun was attempted, pending a decision by the platform team / Lead on how to preserve the scene and diagnose the issue.

As of 10-16 02:22, the main database copy is 256,315,392 bytes with a 0-byte WAL (likely auto-checkpointed when the writer process closed), and its SHA-256 is `a1a4b180415f30a8dbceec8c73314de9323fe793c7fac5d5087e2916fa814e93`. This hash **is solely for locating the corrupted file and is not a usable final delivery hash**. The previous database was not modified by this task, and no final new file was created. Reliable post-continuation counts of `documents`/`pages`/`errors` are unavailable because count queries immediately trigger the corruption exception.

Conclusion: The continuation log completed, but the database integrity gate failed; delivery is paused and this copy must not be used for ticket 0069 ingestion. Prior to the restart, the copy passed integrity check (`ok`, 103,620 pages); the exact cause of corruption remains undetermined and should not be attributed to the script or 9p without evidence.

## Root-Drive Continuation Acceptance (10-16 02:32, EDT)

The root-drive log shows `DONE 2498 errors 2 empty 72 wall_s 6074.8`, taking ~1 h 41 min 15 s; the process exited naturally, requiring no further start, stop, or scheduled check-in. Running `PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` against the root-drive database returned `(0,0,0)`, and a full `PRAGMA integrity_check` returned `ok`. Read-only verification shows `documents` = 1,713, `pages` = 105,336, and `errors` = 2; the sum of page records and error records is 105,338, so **105,336 successful pages must not be misstated as 105,338 successful pages**.

Both failures occurred in the same PDF (SHA-256 `a15a0660a3c55e5b44b28250c7063eea364eec23ae5595d2a4d61d9fe4cd28ce`): physical PDF pages 41 and 45 both hit the 180 s timeout during single-page rendering via `pdftoppm -scale-to 1800 -gray -png` (logged at ~180.180 s and ~180.102 s, respectively). Neither page was rerun or repaired.

A new final copy was created on the root drive (where none existed previously); both the source database and the final copy are 256,282,624 bytes with matching SHA-256 `2f2a3e8625eaf9d5c923caa2ec4d88fd0227407e767b52502319b1ca2c830a6b`, and the final copy independently passed `integrity_check=ok`. The corrupted copy on the mounted drive is preserved untouched. The root-drive final database may be used as downstream input for ticket 0069, provided the two timed-out pages above are explicitly excluded or handled during ingestion rather than counted as successfully OCR'd.

# 台式机第三阶段 OCR — 阶段性终版（2 页失败待单独处理）

10-15 10:29（美东）检查复用 ControlMaster socket 存活；台式机 24 核、46 GiB 内存、WSL 盘空闲 664 GiB。台式机原 PDF 只读，未在 工作站 做 OCR，也未外送页图/文本，0 CU。台式机 工作目录 为本阶段唯一计算输出位置。

## 环境与试跑

台式机无 root sudo；复用另一项书籍任务在 免 root 解包的 Tesseract 4（eng、chi_sim）及系统现有 poppler `pdftoppm`，未安装或更改系统包。首次 200 页测试因 `pdftoppm -singlefile ... -` 不向 stdout 输出而全部渲染失败；在没有写入有效页面的前提下清掉这 200 条错误记录，修正命令后原样重试 200 页：36.2 秒、195 页有文本、5 页空、0 失败；6 个 nice 19/ionice idle 工作线程。此速度只代表该组 Book 优先页面，不是全库保证速度。按该组吞吐朴素外推剩余约 5.3 小时；跨书扫描质量、台式机并发的另两项书籍 OCR 会使实际耗时变化，建议按约 5–10 小时观察心跳。

## 输入与断点

从 工作站 排除原 `page_text.sqlite` 中已标 `origin='OCR 文本'` 的 24,615 页，生成 105,338 页候选清单，传到台式机。优先 Book/Codes、wind engineering、Probability、Vibration、CFD、Mathematics 等，再其它 Book，最后 Literature。台式机后台 PID 63579； 每 60 秒心跳，SQLite 的 `(sha256,physical_page)` 主键断点续跑，成功、空页和异常分别记录；6 线程，单页图像只在内存经 subprocess stdout 传递，无临时 PDF/页图。10:29 查询 SQLite 740 页（721 页有文字），0 错误；全量远未完成。当前该工作目录实占约 63 MiB，另书籍任务目录约 197 MiB，远低于三任务合计 10 GB。

## 损坏 PDF

第一阶段失败清单有重复行，排除第二阶段已经补录的两件后，尝试使用只安装到 的 pypdf 6.20.1（strict=False）在 另存副本，原件不动；独立 `repaired_pages.sqlite` 防止与 OCR 主库同时写冲突。10:29 修复进程 PID 66649 仍在运行，结果尚未核实。pypdf 的修复能力不等同 qpdf/mutool；未能正确映射的页不得冒充成功。

## 10-15 14:31 美东回访
复用 socket 存活；台式机 OCR 主进程 PID 63579 仍运行。日志最近心跳为 34,892/105,138、0 错、572 空页（日志进度略滞后）；只读 SQLite 实查 35,267 条，其中 34,690 条有文本、577 条为空，错误表 0 条。注意候选清单为 105,338 页，而日志分母 105,138，差 200 页试跑已单独完成；最终须按清单与 SQLite 主键并集核对，不得以日志分母直接宣称全覆盖。按至今 13,953 秒与 35,267 条粗算，余下约 7.7 小时，此为动态估计。台式机 实占 150 MiB、 280 MiB、 不存在，三者远低于 10 GB；台式机 WSL 空闲 661 GB，工作站 C 盘空闲 91 GB。修复进程已退出，独立库暂有 366 页，但修复日志仍记录部分文件 Invalid object in /Pages，未核对正确物理页映射、不可并入正式输出。

## 10-15 18:33 美东回访
复用 socket 正常；主进程 PID 63579 为 SNl+，仍以 6 worker 运行。只读 SQLite 查询时已记 66,940 页（66,146 页有文本、794 页为空），随后 origin 汇总达 66,950 页；errors 表为 0。日志心跳 66,720/105,138（另有 200 页试跑），0 错、789 空；以 SQLite 最新页数计，105,338 页目标尚余 38,388 页。按日志累计吞吐约 2.42 页/秒，动态外推约 4.4 小时，不承诺完成时间。 236 MiB、 280 MiB、 未建立，合计低于 10 GB；台式机 WSL 空闲 661 GB，工作站 C 盘空闲 95 GB。修复日志仍有 FE-Handbook-1.pdf 的 Invalid object in /Pages，独立修复库未核页、未并入。运行中的数据库未复制或导出。

## 10-15 23:42 美东回访：台式机存储异常，中断
复用 socket 存活，但原 PID 63579 不在；末次心跳 23:13:37（日志本次运行已处理 102,621/105,138，另有试跑 200 页），只读 SQLite 实查 102,850/105,338 页：101,042 页有字、1,808 页空，errors 0，尚余 2,488 页。 313 MiB、 280 MiB、 不存在，低于 10 GB；工作站 可用 98 GB。原进程消失且无 DONE 记录。一次按主键断点续跑尝试在打开追加日志前失败：`cannot create ocr_round2.log: Read-only file system`，未重启 OCR、未后续写盘。远端根卷显示 `rw,...,emergency_ro`，不能仅凭 df 空闲判断可写。已向平台 Lead 报异常，等安全恢复，不绕过只读故障。独立修复库尚未核页、正式库未传 工作站。

## 10-16 00:49 美东：恢复并按主键续跑
复用 socket 存活；台式机根卷已恢复 ext4 `rw`，宿主 E: 可用 104 GB。确认原 OCR 无进程后，在 复制 SQLite 与当时 WAL/SHM 三件；在副本运行 `PRAGMA integrity_check=okproc_3f36e8f22bd1`、PID 3381642。约 00:53 远端 SQLite 达 103,020 页、0 错，E: 可用 115 GB。200 页试跑已计入总清单。工作站 不运行 OCR。

## 10-16 02:38 美东：停写、核对和交付

断点续跑进程已退出，末行 `DONE 2498 errors 2 empty 72 wall_s 6074.8`；本次续跑墙钟约 2.432 秒/页（6 工作者并行，非单线程 OCR 耗时）。首次 200 页的 36.2 秒是有偏的 Book 小样本；全程跨中断及并发，不能由这两个数准确推定全量纯 OCR 耗时。复用 SSH socket 存活；台式机源库只读、没有在 工作站 运行 OCR 或对外发送页文本，0 CU。

候选唯一主键 105,338 个（含 200 页试跑）；SQLite 完成 105,336 页，其中有文本 103,456、空文本 1,880、失败 2。逐主键差集恰是 物理页 41 与 45；`pdftoppm` 各超过 180 秒限时。`errors` 表正好两条；没有以空白页代替失败页。`PRAGMA integrity_check=ok`，`chars`、`has_text` 与存储文本逐行一致，导出的 105,336 条 manifest 均与输入键相交且无额外键。

20 页抽查：以固定种子 20261016 从已入库页等概率抽 20 页，均有非空可辨文字；中文页的字形误认、英文符号误认、公式/表格跨行与双栏混排都可见。例如 p24 的表格有 `Al OBE`、`WARE`， p396 的公式行几乎不可读， p178 的中文有“午新排列”，而 p302 英文段落相对连贯。这只是文本可读性抽检，没有逐张原图人工对字，故无字符准确率和数值可靠性结论；公式、引文须回原件核验。

修复独立库 有 366 页，均来自 `Computational Statistics Handbook with Matlab`。原件 `pdfinfo` 为 626 页，pypdf 修复副本仅识别 366 页，物理页映射不安全，未并入交付库；其它五条修复尝试报。六件异常仍须单独处理，不得将修复副本的第 N 页直接当原 PDF 第 N 页。

停止写入后执行 WAL checkpoint、完整性检查并传回 工作站。远端 与本地 的 SHA-256 均为 `2f2a3e8625eaf9d5c923caa2ec4d88fd0227407e767b52502319b1ca2c830a6b`；本地大小 256,282,624 字节。 为 1,579,186 字节，SHA-256 `87ab1b229f9222e3af9a2e75a417c42cfcb542adac62284a170ea3686f7faa55`；每行含 sha256、物理页、字符数、有无文本、`origin=OCR 文本本地盘` 可用 98 GB；台式机 约 799 MiB，另 约 280 MiB，低于 10 GB 闸门。

结论：105,336 个已安全对齐页可供平台以 OCR 不保证准确的标签试入库；两处超时及六件损坏文件保持失败/待核，不声称 105,338 页全成功。

# 0069 Work-Merge Verification Queue (Read-Only Verification by the Lab)

Source: (127 groups); the Lab maps `DSK` prefixes to SHA-256; both and were opened via read-only URIs. Verdicts are detailed in , with one group per row listing all `DSK` IDs in the group; this is strictly for manual reference by the platform and does not authorize index writes.

Groups: 127; `DSK` members: 337; merge: 108, do not merge: 18, uncertain: 1.

Verification method: compare verbatim hashes of the first six pages and non-short pages (≥350 normalized characters) across files; then inspect overtly conflicting titles, chapter/volume numbers, member page counts, file paths, and body-text overlap for representative full books. The original queue retains first-page snippets, first-six-page overlap counts, and similarity scores; and are available for cross-checking.

Key findings: Group 1 comprises two volumes of ICWE12 that share front matter but differ in subsequent content; Groups 3–4 have metadata errors that mislabel distinct papers with identical titles; Group 21 consists of 56 separate Davenport conference papers and should not be merged; Group 48 comprises three Bimba product catalogs that share the first four pages but differ thereafter; Groups 49–52, 74, and 127 represent separate chapters/fascicles; Group 89 pairs a standard with its commentary/supplement (distinct documents). Group 70 (ABAQUS lecture notes) has extensive overlap but unclear versioning/inserts, so it is listed separately as uncertain and kept unmerged.

Judgment boundary: complete body-text copies of the same paper with different byte representations may be recommended for merging; however, this recommendation is not itself the Crossref verification required by platform rules. If the platform permits merging solely on the basis of identical SHA or Crossref-verified DOI/title (+year), the remaining "merge" rows must first undergo independent metadata verification, and identical body text in this table must not be treated as satisfying platform rules.

items.title: Review Brief: Low Page-Level Retrieval Hit Rate on Desktop Literature — Seeking Diagnosis and Solutions (L22 · 10-17)
items.text:
# 审查材料：台式机文献按页检索命中率偏低，求诊断与解决办法（L22 · 10-17）

## 背景
- ` pages` 是本中心的本地全文检索工具，按页检索，返回"哪篇、PDF 第几页"。服务代码在 （ 检索与排序， 台式机来源， 建索引， 参数）。
- 语料分三块：
 - Zotero 与 EndNote 两个库，约 13.7k 个作品、45.7 万页，已经验收
 - 台式机 I:\Literature 的书和论文，已入索引 30.9 万页（来源 `page_text_v2`，11,134 份文档）
 - 另有两个增量交付了但**还没入索引**：DjVu/超星 3.1 万页、OCR 第二轮 10.5 万页。`desk_sources` 表里只有 `page_text_v2` 一条。
- 检索流程（据 config）：
 1. 中文问句先由 Gemini Flash 翻成英文
 2. FTS/BM25 召回（含 CJK 表），用 bge-small 重排，重排池 100
 3. 书籍另走一个通道（bge-reranker-base，book_slots=2）
 4. 最后取前 5。
- 台式机文档按 sha256 去重。书目元数据大多是低置信度：`low_homelow_filename` 时显示文件名，标"题目候选"。

## 盲测（只留实验室，题目原文不外送）
- 题库：30 题，由台式机文档构造，SHA，冻结不改。问句为中文。分四组：书（有文字层）、论文、中文文献、OCR 扫描页，各 10/10/5/5 题。
- 判据：前 5 条结果里有正确作品，且 PDF 物理页误差 ±1。
- 10-16 晚的复跑：翻译 30/30 成功，作品命中 15/30，到页 11/30。分组到页：书 4/10，论文 4/10，中文 1/5，OCR 2/5。
- 逐题表见 `per_question_sanitized.mddesk_pages` 核过），所以失败不是覆盖问题，全部是召回/排序问题：
 - 15 题，正确作品没进前 5
 - 4 题，作品对了但页错。其中 R5-03 返回的是另一副本的页码（250，目标 50）；R5-25、R5-27、R5-30 是同一文档内页选错。
- 同一服务在两库上的老题库（R3 共 30 题，R4 共 12 道书题）稳定在 24/30 和 8/12，0069 上线后没有退步。
- 失败集中在论文组（6/10 没召回）和书组。论文组目标文档只有 9–16 页，而且多数书目是 `low_home`，没有可靠题名。

## 平台已排进 0069 第三轮的四条改进（尚未上线）
1. 中文原文和英译两路检索
2. 台式机与两库分别召回再合并，题名高置信时加权
3. 同作品的各副本返回自己的物理页
4. 用 desktop_records_v3 的题名替换文件名。

回归要求：两库逐题不降，耗时增加 ≤5 秒。

## 请回答
1. 根据代码和数据，**15 道作品没召回**最可能的根因是什么？请排序，并给出每条的证据或可以验证的办法。可能的方向（不限于此）：
 - 翻译后的英文查询与原文用词不匹配
 - BM25 被两库的大量页面稀释，或台式机页在融合时被压低
 - 重排池 100 不够，或重排模型太弱
 - 书通道挤占名额
 - 去重或别名把正确文档折叠掉了
 - 短论文页数少，文档级证据不足。
2. 上面四条改进能解决哪些、解决不了哪些？
3. 请提出**具体的、可落地的附加办法**（改哪个函数或参数、预期影响、风险），按"收益/代价"排序。要满足：不能让两库老题库退步，耗时增加 ≤5 秒，书籍全文不外送。
4. 给一个**诊断实验方案**：用最小代价在复测前把根因分开。例如对失败题记录目标页在各阶段的名次（BM25 名次、重排前后、融合后），只开台式机来源单独检索做对照，等等。
5. 两个尚未入索引的增量（DjVu/超星、OCR 第二轮）入索引后，预计会帮忙还是添乱？要注意什么？

只读，不改任何文件，不调用会改动服务的命令。可以读代码和 `index.sqlite`（只读）。

# 裁决：审查 （台式机按页检索 11/30 的根因与解决办法）· 10-17 17:35

3/3 份有效意见（Gemini、GPT-6、GLM）。Lead 已逐条核过代码和数据：、 第 1359–1407、1440–1476、720–742 行，以及 `index.sqlite` 的 desk_sources。

## 必须改
1. **我的 brief 写错了两处**：
 - 45.7 万页、13.7k 作品是三块语料的合计。Zotero+EndNote 只有约 14.7 万页（两位审稿人独立算出 147,345 页）。
 - 台式机本来就是独立分表召回，"被两库 BM25 稀释"这条假设作废。平台四条改进里的"中英两路"和"分库召回再合并"在现行代码里已经有了，第三轮不能按字面重做。
2. **头号根因是合并门控（已核实）**：`desktop_merge` 的设置是 slots=1、ref=max、margin=2.0。意思是每题最多只放 1 条台式机结果进前 5，而且它的重排分要比两库第 1 名还高 2 分才能进。
 - 8 道作品未召回题的前 5 里一条台式机结果都没有（R5-04/07/11/17/18/19/21/23）。
 - 3 道同书错页题（R5-25/27/30）里，目标书已经排第 1，但同书第二页被 slots=1 挡住，进不了前 5。

 这是第三轮最该动的参数，平台原来的四条都没碰它。
3. **台式机召回池偏小**：desktop_pool=30（两库是 100），desktop_alt=false（第二种英文问法关着），book_channel_desktop=false（台式机的书不走书通道）。书组 5 道未召回与此对应。
4. **合并前去重是按页而不是按作品**（ftkb.py:1373 用 `dedup(desk,10)`，按 (work,page) 分组）。同一本书的几页会占满候选名额（现为 4 个），别的台式机作品拿不到打分机会。
5. **第四条改进（v3 题名）要写清范围**：现规则只有 high_*/medium_pdfinfo 显示题名，low_home 和 low_filename 仍用文件名，而 FTS 的 title 列权重是 2。论文组 9/10 是 low_home，题名不可靠，就等于把文件名当题名在检索。需要先做题名可靠性提升（首页抽题名、用 Crossref 回填），并清洗 medium_pdfinfo 里的乱码和模板名，不能只是"再指定一次 v3"。
6. **诊断要留档**："目标页 30/30 已入索引"的查询脚本和逐题 sha 映射要存进实验室私有目录；对外只给结论。

## 仅供参考
- Gemini 说的"中文保底槽位（索引 3–4）被候选上限截断"：代码结构上成立（candidates 上限 3→4 后仍可能截掉），但要等逐题 trace 确认。另外 10-16 上午未翻译时中文组 5/5 作品命中、晚上翻译后 2/5，这条线索可靠，列为第二优先。
- GPT-6：重排只读题名加正文前 1200 字（rerank_window=head）；OCR 增量替换旧 OCR 页时不比较文本质量；"总数不变"不等于"逐题不降"，回归必须逐题对照。
- GLM：逐题表的"前5中DSK条数"把挂靠的副本也算进去了，不能用来判断台式机是否被召回。

## 未采纳的异议
- GPT-6 主张撤回"失败全是召回/排序问题"：部分采纳。GLM 已核对代码，desk_pages 与 FTS 写入是同步的，所以"已入索引≈可检索"成立。但目标页的文字是否抽得完整，没有逐页核过，改为"目标页都已入索引，失败主要发生在召回和合并阶段"。

## 事实更新
平台已于 10-17 17:13 把 djvu_pdg（31,020 页）和 ocr_round2（103,082 页）入索引，台式机现有 443,514 页。brief 写的"未入索引"是 11:58 的状态。

## 下一步（Lead 决定）
- 把以上 1–5 条和下面的诊断方案交平台，并入 0069 第三轮。
- 平台在自己的开发集（dev_desktop 等）上，用 desktop_merge 的 record 模式记下每题 head_ce、各候选分和名次，扫描 slots∈{1,2,3}、ref∈{max,pos}、margin∈{0,0.5,1,2}、desktop_pool∈{30,100}、按作品去重、台式机书入书通道等组合。
- 约束不变：R3/R4 和两库开发集逐题不降，耗时增加 ≤5 秒。
- 上线后实验室用冻结的 R5 盲测复测（题目不交平台）。

# ftkb 0069 冻结盲测验收（10-16 10:39，美东）

结论口径：本次观察不支持放行新台式机 I 盘来源检索；R5 前五到页仅 5/30，且 30/30 次调用均提示「本次未翻译……只按中文原文检索」，是显著的检索条件故障/混杂因素，不能把英文资料 0 命中直接归因于 0069 的索引或重排。旧书纵向集没有到页退步，也没有新增提升。题目、答案、原始片段只留实验室，不向平台交付。

## 方法及冻结

每道只送原问题给 ` pages … -n 5` 一次、单题 90 s 超时，先核冻结文件 SHA-256：R5 `8e08ae4bd5ba725e6dd2d2df80032e9ff35880cf8a88a4ab601e6a29ef1f1b07`、R3 `d80069db26f2bc53914f58d73556ef283d216ffd513a71ea3aac5c1bf10bd83b`、R4 `9259a4092267a0bd8cfa23c40252f9e6f36c64bee05e8e32055c4ddf0b987c46`；题库均未改。全部 72 次退出码 0，均未超时。前五以同作品且原 PDF 物理页 ±1 为到页；R5 同作品按原始 I 盘路径转换 Windows 路径（去「只在台式机能打开」尾注）/已记别名精确匹配，不把不完整文件名的相似题名算作同作。R3/R4 沿原有作品判据、跨库同作。可能的同书异路径未经逐份哈希核验，保守不加分。第六条补充页不计入前五。

## R5 新题：30 道严格真值

OCR 5 道已经 Lead 目视原 PDF 页核实；R5-30 题干欠限定，保留冻结问句，未命中不另算。每组前五作品命中 / 到页：

| 分组 | 题数 | 作品 | 物理页±1 | 未到页题号 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Book 文字层 | 10 | 0 | 0 | R5-01–10 |
| Literature | 10 | 0 | 0 | R5-11–20 |
| 中文 | 5 | 5 | 3 | R5-21、25 |
| OCR | 5 | 3 | 2 | R5-26、27、30 |
| 合计 | 30 | 8 | 5 | 25 道 |

同作品却页错：R5-21 返回 PDF 380 页、R5-25 返回第 6 页、R5-30 返回第 258 页；目标物理页和前五原始片段仅见实验室私有文件。R5-30 按预定口径不额外扣分，依旧记一题未到页。其余 22 道未召回同作，不等于源文件必然没索引。原始回包 R5 全部 30 道出现「本次未翻译」警告；英文作品问句落在中文原词检索条件下，尤其 Book/Literature 0/20，不宜由此判定长书索引本身完全失效。R3/R4 的 42 道回包没有此警告，纵向比较检索条件并不相同。

展示/溯源：前五任一条标「只在台式机能打开」为 20/30 题（首位 13/30）；前五任一条题名标「题目候选」为 14/30（首位 7/30）；显式「疑似表格」提示为 2/30（两题均首位）。「只在台式机能打开」的文件路径不能假定 工作站 可直接打开，题名候选不可当作正式书目信息；疑似表格的数字/行列必须返回原页核查。按提示字面统计，不将片段中普通「表格」字眼计入表格警示。

## 长书纵向对照（同一冻结问句、前五）

| 题库 / 分组 | 三期到页 | 0057/首跑到页 | 0062 到页 | 0069 作品 | 0069 到页 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| R3 中文原文 10 | 9 | 9 | 9 | 10 | 9 |
| R3 中文问英文 10 | 8 | 7 | 8 | 9 | 8 |
| R3 原生书 7 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| R3 OCR 书 3 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 1 |
| R3 合计 30 | 24 | 23 | 24 | 27 | 24 |
| R4 原生书 8 | — | 4 | 4 | 5 | 4 |
| R4 OCR 书 4 | — | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| R4 合计 12 | — | 8 | 8 | 9 | 8 |

results.title: Pre-registered criteria (frozen before the search run; do not modify)
results.text:
# Pre-registered Criteria (Frozen before retrieval run, do not modify)

Scope: Papers from local Zotero PDF attachments, excluding books and book chapters; read-only access to the original library. Extraction is performed physical page by physical page of the PDF, with page numbers starting from 1; indices and databases on disk contain only scripts and small evaluation results. Extraction failures and textless pages are tallied and disclosed, without treating text cache as page numbers.

A: At least 30 pre-frozen paraphrased questions, with answers independently verified against original PDF physical pages; covering downbursts, tall building wind pressure, wind spectra, CFD, and structural response, with at least 10 papers having cards in and at least 10 papers without cards. Questions and answers are written to questions.jsonl prior to the first retrieval, recording the question bank SHA-256; questions must not be created verbatim from the same source text. BM25, small CPU dense vector, and hybrid retrieval are all tested on the same questions; for the top-5 results per question (in units of unique paper-page), correct paper and page ±1 counts as a primary metric hit; correct paper only counts as a secondary metric. For , top-5 on the same questions are judged by paper; unverifiable page numbers are recorded as unjudgeable page numbers and do not count as hits. Report raw question-by-question results and grouped hit rates, without using an incomplete subset to pose as 30 questions. Feasibility-in-principle gate: hybrid retrieval primary metric ≥0.70, showing gain over BM25, and coverage ≥0.90; this is only prototype feasibility, not a publication-grade conclusion.

B: 30–40 papers actually containing profiles, including field measurements, wind tunnel, and CFD; send only the text of relevant PDF pages to Gemini 3.8 Flash, prompting to extract strictly based on visible content, leaving missing items blank, preserving page numbers, figure/table numbers, units, normalization, and r/D definitions. At least 60 atomic values are checked value-by-value against original PDF pages, reporting per-field accuracy (correct / checked non-empty values), omission rate (visible on original page but not extracted / fields that should have been extracted from original page), manual verification time per paper, and verifier; readings from figures must be labeled as figure readings, without inferring ambiguous numerical values. Metrics whose experimental measured values do not reach scale are marked 'unevaluated' and cannot be claimed as passed. Uploading full text, using local large models, modifying Zotero, running on supercomputers, or overwriting existing results is prohibited. Log the number of pages sent to external models and call volume. The final recommendation should be selected from 'formal tool/dataset', 'retrieval only', or 'not worthwhile'; if scale is not reached, it can only remain tentative.

results.title: Error types in downburst profile extraction (single-page text experiment)
results.text:
# Downburst Profile Extraction Error Types (Single-Page Text Pilot)

1. Paper category and source confusion: Papers with both numerical/experimental in the title cannot have the source of the profile cited on this page determined based solely on the title. `kind` is a heuristic label, unverified paper by paper, and cannot be treated as field measurement / wind tunnel / CFD ground truth.
2. Mistaking cited paper values for this paper: "almost 80 m" on PDF physical page 2 of `SAI7PQLC` cites Hjelmfelt (1988) and cannot be attributed as the z_max of this paper (verification record already judged as error).
3. Treating normalized velocity as absolute maximum: Vr/Vjet≈1 on p.3 of `EFT4W6FE` cannot be treated as a unified U_max; velocity definitions across different r/D and heights must be separated (verification record already judged invalid).
4. z_max confusion: z_m and u_m on p.15 of `MBLWBMR6` are model symbols, not observed numerical values; Z/D≈0.06 on p.9 of `R5RKQGYZ` is non-dimensional height and must not be recorded as 0.06 m.
5. Distinction between figure reading and text: This round sent only one page of extractable text, with no images sent. Having curves in a figure caption does not mean reading the maximum value off the figure; figure reading precision cannot be reverse-inferred.
6. Misattributing figure numbers: When multiple figures are listed on a page at the same time, if the model only takes Fig. 9 without labeling the corresponding (a)–(d) and r/D, the radial position may be mismatched.
7. Omissions: 34 papers each had one page sent; many papers' relevant parameters are on other pages, and null values do not indicate that the full text has no data; a complete full-text omission rate cannot be computed in this round.
8. Optical character recognition / typesetting: PDF two-column interleaving, ¼/≈, ligatures, and captions blending into main text may lead to misjudgments of units, formula exponents, and page numbers. Journal print pages and PDF physical pages are recorded separately.

Verification principle: The appearance of numbers on the same page is merely literal co-occurrence, which does not prove that they belong to that model, figure/table, or data source; automatic numerical co-occurrence results in are not treated as scientific accuracy.

# Corrections to Inventory Interpretation (Without Modifying the Generated corpus_inventory.md)

The "lower bound of EndNote book markings" in corpus_inventory.md is invalid: the filename heuristic classified `Hill - 2010 - Climate and Tropical Cyclones.pdf` as a book, but the PDF cover page and table of contents show that it is a research degree document; 9 is the count of heuristic candidates, neither an exact value nor a lower bound. The vast majority of EndNote items (1517/1527) are unclassified, making it impossible to give a reliable, complete distribution by book / chapter / thesis / journal article. EndNote bibliographic metadata should first be decoded or manually annotated; 9 cannot be treated as the book count.

"no_text ~3.4% is the lower bound of OCR workload" is also not rigorous: textless files may be pure image scans, or may have extremely short content, corruption, or extractor anomalies; PDFs with text may still contain scanned pages. Therefore, 159/4691=3.39% is the proportion of attachments with entirely no indexable text, which is neither the proportion of scanned files across the full library nor a strict lower bound for OCR. In , 159 items total 10,553 physical pages; if all require OCR, approx. this many pages would need to be processed, but this is a conditional scale estimate, not a confirmed count of scanned pages. Another 31 items had extraction failures/timeouts and cannot be counted as scans. Follow-up work requires sampling PDF page images to re-estimate actual OCR workload.

Cross-library merging relies solely on Zotero DOIs and normalized filename titles, while EndNote lacks structured DOIs; the 3,845 in represents "candidate work clusters" rather than a verified count of unique documents. In particular, both false merges of different editions with the same title and missed merges due to truncated filenames may occur. The 87/32/60 user-provided Zotero itemTypes are entry counts; the corresponding visible PDF attachments in this round are 73/26/50, representing different counting targets.

# Dual-Library and Books Supplementary Pilot Conclusions (10-13, US Eastern)

## Scope and Methods
Read-only access to Zotero PDF attachments and EndNote Phd.Data/PDF; production libraries were not touched, and other PDFs in Downloads were not included. Zotero sqlite was read-only from a WSL pre-copied replica, and EndNote .enl was unparsed. Continued using the previous round's SQLite FTS5 BM25 page index, incrementally indexed locally; a CJK trigram index was separately built for Chinese, and a limited fixed wind-engineering Chinese-English terminology table was attempted during querying. No new online services, Gemini, GPU/Colab (0 CU), or supercomputers were used; full text of books was never sent externally. New criteria were written before incremental retrieval evaluation, and old were not modified. The 6 newly added questions were all non-first physical pages of books, including 3 Chinese questions; the original 34 Chinese questions were also retested after the library expansion.

## Inventory
| Library | PDF Attachments | Extractable Text | Entirely Textless | Extraction Failure/Timeout | Index Newly Added Readable Physical Pages |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Zotero | 3164 | 3061 | 83 | 20 | 128,708 pages combined with EndNote |
| EndNote | 1527 | 1440 | 76 | 11 | 128,708 pages combined with Zotero |

The previous Zotero index excluding books and book chapters has been completed in this round, making a total of 4,501 attachments and 128,708 non-empty physical pages searchable; source PDF sizes are Zotero 16.53 GiB, EndNote 6.24 GiB. Candidate merge results based on normalized titles / usable DOIs yielded 3,845 clusters; EndNote lacks structured DOIs and has truncated filenames, and has not been verified as an accurate unique document count. In-library PDF attachments by Zotero parent itemType: book 73, bookSection 26, thesis 50, journalArticle 2870, other 145; not the same basis as the full-library itemType entry counts of 87/32/60. 1517/1527 EndNote items cannot be reliably classified solely by filename; its 9 "book" heuristic candidates contain false positives and cannot serve as the real count of books. First-page text heuristics classifying English / Chinese / mixed / unknown see details in . 159 entirely textless attachments total 10,553 physical pages, but this cannot be used to determine the proportion of scanned files, nor can OCR time be directly estimated; 31 extraction failures are counted separately. corrects two overly strong statements in the automated inventory report.

## Same-Question Retrieval (Top 5, PDF Physical Page ±1)
| Question Group / System | Page Correct | Document Correct | Notes |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Original English 34 questions, expanded library BM25 | 25/34 | 29/34 | All first-page questions; |
| Original English 34 questions, expanded library BGE-small-en hybrid | 27/34 | 29/34 | CPU reranking only on top 60 BM25 pages, not full-library vector index; |
| Added 6 book questions, expanded library BM25 | 1/6 | 1/6 | All internal book pages |
| Added 6 book questions, CJK trigram + limited terminology table | 1/6 | 2/6 | Poor retrieval when paraphrased; first exact long-string configuration was 2/6 pages, here is the revised trigram segmentation result |
| Original Chinese 34 questions, expanded library BM25 | 0/34 | 2/34 | Chinese questions on English papers |
| Original Chinese 34 questions, CJK trigram + limited terminology table | 0/34 | 0/34 | Regressed compared to BM25, cannot be called usable for cross-lingual retrieval |

Question-by-question top 5, answer keys, and page numbers see and ; improved script . Using specific Chinese keywords "微下击暴流 水平尺度 生命周期" (microburst horizontal scale life cycle) in CJK can return page 23 of the Chinese monograph PDF (already tested), but natural language paraphrased B04 only hit the document, missing the page; Chinese paraphrases of English papers cannot be resolved by Chinese character trigrams. The 6 added book questions are both small in number and carry question ambiguity, and cannot be extrapolated to overall accuracy; the original English first-page questions cannot prove real cross-page fact search. Duplicate PDFs between the two libraries are indexed separately by source key, which crowds top-5 slots; cross-library same-work merging has not yet entered retrieval result deduplication.

## Recommendations
Retain only the local full-text retrieval prototype, without connecting to formal or constructing a reusable wind engineering dataset based on this. Expanding the library is feasible (page, book, and Chinese text indices can all be built); but internal book pages at 1/6 and cross-lingual Chinese at 0/34 failed the quality gate. Next, if a decision is made to invest, first decode EndNote metadata / calibrate book types and cross-library duplicates before conducting multilingual retrieval and an independent cross-page question bank; OCR must sample scanned pages first. The 60-item manual verification gate for the original downburst extraction sample table is still uncompleted, and this supplement has not changed its "cannot be ingested" status.

# Post-Hoc Quality Verdict on the Frozen Question Bank (Without Modifying SHA or Raw Results)

The question bank questions_round2.jsonl was frozen before retrieval, SHA-256: 4ec35a6695ad021116533fd3e1ef33f11999d716d6a32232c20fa58217a21cb0. Fixed at 30 questions; same-question scoring across all systems is detailed in retrieval_round2_rows.csv. After inspecting the physical pages of standard answers, the following three questions were found to have factual/attribution discrepancies and were symmetrically excluded across all systems, without modifying original questions or supplementing questions:

R17: The question stated that the buffeting factor tending toward 1 after 17–18% turbulence intensity was from the current twin tall-building experiment, whereas the original page was actually recounting external research by Taniike (1991) (PDF key T474JX49 p8). Classified as citation misattribution.

R24: The question stated approx. 10% as the "upper bound of phase lag" between motion and aerodynamic force; this value is actually the energy contribution of the first POD mode, and two-column text extraction strung non-uniform lag from the other column into the same sentence (END-96601aaef4ee6b2d p12). Classified as two-column text interleaving.

R30: The question asked about the upper bound of multichannel acquisition time delay, but the standard answer anchor was merely "up to 35 channels", which is not a time delay; numerical quantities on the page were broken apart by two-column interleaving, preventing correct fact localization based on it (END-93a00b9d52d359a7 p4). Classified as answer anchor error.

Therefore, "30 original questions" and "27 valid factual questions" are reported side by side, never reporting only the favorable one. Valid questions 27 < required ≥30, so the strict scale gate for the Round 2 question bank was not passed. One cannot add questions after seeing retrieval results to masquerade as the pre-frozen 30 questions. Sampling was conducted by manual selection of pages with clear facts after preliminary screening with a fixed random seed, rather than a strictly uniform random sample of pages/papers; the question bank does not represent the full-library user query distribution.

Further checking of the first two pages of the PDFs revealed that among the six questions selected with Zotero parent itemType=book, R03 is a government research report by Willoughby, and R04 is explicitly labeled Technical Report (2002); although labeled book, they cannot be counted as physical books. Physical books or bound guides comprise only four questions: R01, R02, R05, and R06; thus, the strict gate of "≥5 book questions" was also not passed. The original six supplementary book questions (questions_books_supplement.jsonl) belong to materials already run in Round 1 and cannot be mixed into Round 2 independent new questions to make up numbers. Both the original book metadata group of 6 questions and the physical book group of 4 questions retain their raw results, never altering group labels to hide issues.
