# B2 Round 1 Preregistration v1 (Frozen Before Computing Any Station Wind Speeds)
Time: 10-14 20:02 EDT. Criteria and 19 stations are from the 10-14 19:25 frozen version. This document will not be modified hereafter; if pre-checks reveal that the data structure is non-executable, a separate v2 will be established, preserving this document. Parameters must not be tuned against ASCE values.

## Cohort, Definitions, and Workflow
RAFT uses only Zenodo 10392725 40,000 tracks; STORM uses only the 4TU present-climate IBTrACS version 2 (12706085/2) North Atlantic ten 1,000-year files, totaling 10,000 years. Strictly preserve original catalog storm intensity, track, and RMW; exclude missing/unphysical nodes (Pc<=0, RMW<=0, POCI<=Pc), but do not delete storms based on results. Both catalogs are linearly interpolated between track nodes to 15 min (no extrapolation), with longitudes first handled for dateline crossings; for the same station, take the peak 3 s gust over the entire lifecycle of each storm. Screening: Storms whose original nodes are >500 km from all 19 stations can be omitted, but the nearest distance along track segments (including segments passing near stations) must be checked, and the number screened out must be reported; finally, H08 takes only center distances <=300 km (following B1+B4 v1). The zero wind field at the first node is a CLIMADA implementation detail, no need to extrapolate endpoints. The gate must not be altered by selecting more favorable times, radii, or stations.

Wind field uses the identical CLIMADA 6.1.0 tag commit `bb9595944fcf673152ea53e61efbafeb0b1e4406` H08 `_compute_windfields` and `tctrack_to_si`. Input raw RMW; CLIMADA H08 computes wind using Pc, POCI, RMW, and translational speed, **and does not use track vmax to determine H08 wind speed** (source code lines 205–246, 1297–1330). Therefore, STORM's 10-min→1-min = 1.11 is used only for input definition recordkeeping/diagnostics and does not alter the main calculation results; it must not be claimed that the original maximum winds of the two catalogs are identical. POCI is not provided in track files of either catalog; fixed assumption of 1010 hPa, with sensitivity at 1005/1015 hPa. Winds generated by CLIMADA are understood on a 10 m open water 1 min baseline.

Logarithmic layer from sea surface to open terrain from B1+B4 v1: F=[ln(10/.03)/ln(500/.03)]/[ln(10/.0013)/ln(500/.0013)], applied uniformly to all stations (no directional terrain sampling); surface z0=0.03 m, sea surface z0=0.0013 m, with 500 m as the assumed reference height, sensitivity 200/1000 m. The 3 s open terrain gust takes **a total factor of 1.07 on the sea surface 1 min baseline** (Simiu et al. 2007 PDF pp. 1–3 / Table 1: 10 m open water 1 min → 10 m open terrain 3 s); thus, sea surface 1 min wind is first multiplied by F, and then multiplied by 1.07/F (i.e., net multiplication by 1.07); this formulation guarantees no double-counting of roughness. Sensitivity is performed for total factors 1.03/1.12; additionally, note on the relationship between F and the accompanying gust factor under reference heights of 200/1000 m: as long as the literature total factor is held fixed, F cancels out, and varying F cannot be treated as an independent physical sensitivity. This coefficient applies only to tropical cyclones and is not transferred to thunderstorm / mixed climates.

## Annual Rate, Return Period, and Uncertainty
STORM specifies 10,000 synthetic years, using in-file year + file sequence number to form global years; storm-free years are retained in the total year count. In RAFT data, `year` is a randomly sampled ERA5 environmental year 1979–2018, not a simulation year; neither the paper nor Zenodo provides the equivalent number of years. **Assume** that RAFT's annual occurrence rate is the same as STORM's North Atlantic present-climate 14.5 storms/year (Bloemendaal et al. 2020 Sci Data PDF Table 3 / corresponding storm count, requiring page-by-page verification), RAFT equivalent years = 40000/14.5; sensitivity 10–20 storms/year. For year-block bootstrap, storms will be grouped by fixed storm_ID order into contiguous synthetic year blocks of 14/15 events (deterministic, uniform allocation; not treating ERA5 years as independent years); this is a proxy sampling that does not capture shared environmental year correlations. The primary estimate ranks storm peaks per station, annual exceedance rate λ(v) = number of storm peaks exceeding v / equivalent years; Weibull plotting: using the k-th value from largest to smallest, with k/(Nstorm+1)×Nstorm/Nyear, perform **linear interpolation of wind speed** between adjacent points for the target 1/T, with out-of-range values not extrapolated and recorded as missing; zero-storm wind speeds are not added to the ranking but retain equivalent years. An annual block having any storm exceeding the threshold serves as an additional check for annual exceedance and must not be conflated with λ. Block bootstrap with replacement 300 times, fixed RNG seed=20261014, 90% percentile interval; if target tail samples are insufficient, use null, do not fit the tail.

Gate 0: When ASCE values are obtained for >=12 stations, the station median of STORM V700/ASCE V700-1 is within ±20%. If failed, AI is not evaluated. Gate 1: After passing Gate 0, RAFT station V700 median absolute deviation relative to ASCE is <=15%, and <=1.1× the same metric for STORM. If ASCE has fewer than 12 stations, Gates 0/1 are not evaluated, and only the relative comparison predetermined on the project page is conducted: RAFT vs STORM V700 station median absolute difference <=15%, and median signed differences across all four predetermined coastal segments are all <=25% in absolute value. If any of the four segments has no valid stations, it must not be claimed to pass. V50 is reported only.

19 stations original order: KBRO KCRP KGLS KLCH KMSY KGPT KMOB KPNS KAAF KTPA KRSW KEYW KMIA KPBI KMLB KJAX KCHS KILM KHSE. Exact coordinates according to IEM ASOS station table; four coastal segments follow the project page geographic order: first 5 / next 4 (KGPT–KAAF) / next 6 (KTPA–KMLB) / next 4 (KJAX–KHSE); spherical approximate shortest distance from each station to Natural Earth 10m coastline categorized into <10, 10–50, >50 km (offshore sea points also take absolute distance, without adjusting speeds based on this). At the V50/V700 level, using storms with peak >= return period level as the denominator, the ratio of center distance at peak time / then-current RMW is categorized into <1, 1–3, >3 bins, with exact boundary 1 entering 1–3, and 3 entering >3; report counts/proportions, exclude missing RMW and report the count. NA / zero denominators must not impersonate 0.

ASCE 7-22 50/700 MRI values are retrieved only from public location tools / GIS, retaining each station's source and raw mph value; no account used, no reading curves from standard PDFs; record missing if unavailable. The ASCE map is multi-hazard all-climate (this experiment is TC only), so discrepancies cannot be entirely attributed to wind field errors.

## Parameter Sources Table (Frozen Before Pre-check)
| Parameter | Value | Source / Status | Checked |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RAFT wind speed definition | 10 m max sustained 1 min; kt | Xu et al. 2024 Sci Data PDF pp. 3–5 Intensity/Table 1 | Original paper, Zenodo record |
| RAFT pressure/RMW | Pc=1030.222−0.730 vmax(kt), RMW=48.7 exp(0.0163637 lat−0.01450866 vmax) nmi; main chain directly reads nc raw values | Xu et al. 2024 PDF p. 4 Eqs. 2, 3 | Original paper, Zenodo fields |
| RAFT equivalent years | 40000/14.5, range 40000/10–40000/20 | **Assumption**, RAFT original text does not state equivalent years, `year` is environmental year, 14.5 events/year in STORM table is only a comparable annual rate proxy | Full original text (pp. 3–5, 9), Zenodo fields, two searches in ; subsequent code repository verification |
| STORM years / wind speed / RMW | 10,000 years; 10 m 10 min m/s, RMW km | Bloemendaal et al. 2020 Sci Data PDF pp. 2, 8 and 4TU 12706085/2 README (pending download and itemized verification) | Original paper, 4TU version/file interface |
| STORM 10 min→1 min | 1.11 (range 1.10–1.12); H08 does not read vmax so does not enter results | Powell et al. 2005 PDF pp. 5–6: marine 1 min is ~10–12% higher than 10 min; not measured for every storm | Card, CLIMADA v6.1.0 source code |
| POCI (both catalogs) | 1010 hPa, sensitivity 1005, 1015 | **Assumption**; track fields lack POCI, required by H08 | Xu 2024 PDF/Table1, Zenodo fields, STORM paper and 4TU fields, ; value must be further checked against external empirical rules, must not impersonate author's parameters |
| Sea-land log layer | z0 sea 0.0013, land 0.03 m, reference 500 m | B1+B4 lines 8–9, reference height **assumption** | Existing frozen chain |
| 1 min sea→3 s open terrain | Net multiply by 1.07, range 1.03–1.12 | Simiu et al. 2007 card |
| H08 defaults / temporal | CLIMADA 6.1.0, 15 min linear; 300 km | Model source code v6.1.0 lines 205–246, 1170–1257, 1297–1330; 15 min B1+B4 v1 line 6 | B1+B4, public source code |

## Resources and Failure Reporting
Priority to local workstation CPU, Colab CPU if necessary; pause and report to Lead if expected >100 CU; no supercomputers. Scripts, catalog lists, station peak tables, return value tables, bootstrap, stratifications, and plots each output separate new files. When data or tools cannot be obtained or statistical criteria are not met, write null and the reason, never synthesize station wind speeds or ASCE values. All relevant new external data/code registered in PUBLIC_CITATIONS.

# B2 Preregistration v3: H08 Input Unit Correction and Quarantine of Invalid Runs
Time: 10-14 20:06 EDT. Calculation results / gates have not yet been opened; v1/v2 and previous Colab , first 6 batches are retained as-is, labeled as **invalid, must not be used for conclusions**. Code inspection of CLIMADA 6.1.0 `tctrack_to_si` lines 1327–1332 revealed that `radius_max_wind` input is in **nautical miles**, and multiplied internally by 1852 to convert to meters; previous scripts mistakenly passed meters first, resulting in double conversion of RMW. The original run group has been stopped; v3 new directory recalculates RAFT/STORM, with the entire chain and criteria still following v1/v2, the sole dimensional correction being: RAFT rmax in original nautical miles is not multiplied by 1852; STORM rmax in original km is divided by 1.852 when passed in; peak distance / RMW binning only multiplies nautical miles back by 1852 m.

Also checked CLIMADA lines 1322–1324: `Pc > POCI` will in `tctrack_to_siresults_v3/`, old files retained as error cases.

# B2 Optional Third Chain SPIN Preregistration Supplement v4 (Before Any Wind Speed Calculations in the Third Chain)
Time: 10-14 20:09 EDT. The main chain v3 and gates remain completely unchanged; only adds the pre-required usable third chain diagnostics. The official SPIN paper Gao & Xi (2026) GMD PDF journal pp. 7305–7307 specifies 14 NeuralGCM members, 10 FAST intensity stochastic realizations per track, theoretically 6,020 simulation years. Zenodo 20795548 v1.0.1 output is ~605 MB, already obtained; inside the archive, is the default tracks filtered by ET, is not the main input; actual file counts / missing years and correlations among the 10 realizations of the same member must be checked. Do not misreport ten intensity realizations of the same track as ten independent paths.

Its track README provides only latitude/longitude, time, and vmax (m/s), **without providing Pc/RMW/POCI**; H08 cannot be directly applied to SPIN. As a purely exploratory, non-gate "SPIN + borrowed RAFT wind-pressure and radius regressions" third chain: let vmax_kt = vmax(m/s)/0.514444; Pc(hPa) = 1030.222−0.730 vmax_kt; RMW(nmi) = 48.7 exp(0.0163637 lat −0.01450866 vmax_kt), from Xu et al. 2024 PDF p. 4 Eqs. 2/3 (not author-provided parameters for SPIN); POCI assumes 1010 hPa, 500 km screening, 15 min interpolation, CLIMADA v6.1.0 H08, 1.07 total conversion same as v3. Use only ET-filtered, actually existing complete member × year × realization files as simulation years, distinguishing "file years" from the fewer independent NeuralGCM track years; V50/V700 plotted empirically following v1, without fitting; if independent year bootstrap is not possible or qualified samples are insufficient, record null for intervals. If duplicate or missing files cannot be clarified, the third chain reports only data availability and does not fabricate calculations. The third chain does not enter gates under any circumstances, and in particular must not be called SPIN native wind field design values.

items.text:
# B2 第一轮：RAFT/STORM 同链设计风速测试（完成报告）

日期：10-14 21:30 EDT。所有结果为研究试验，不能直接作为工程设计或对外发表结论。判据在 冻结；v1–v4 的预注册勘误均保留。本报告只用修正 RMW 输入单位后的 v3 主链；旧 、 的量纲错误批次完全不参与统计。

## 一句话结果
STORM 基线闸过（19/19 有 V700；中位有符号偏差 −8.87%，门槛 ±20%）。RAFT 第一增量闸不过（中位绝对偏差 30.40%，门槛 15%，并远高于 STORM 的 9.21%）；空间相对差异中位 24.78%，超过 15% 门槛。不能按冻结闸门将 RAFT 当作比 STORM 有改进的设计风速输入，更不能调参、删站“救闸”。这是本轮链条的结果，非对 RAFT 数据或模型普适性的否定。

## 数据、风场、统计
- RAFT 北大西洋 40,000 条，原始 40,000、500 km 预筛进入 16,509 条、风场异常 0。Xu et al. 2024 的 RAFT 数据及 Zenodo 记录 [1][2]。其未明示这份 40,000 条子集的模拟总年数，因此主计算假设年发生率 14.5 条/年，等效 2,758.62 年；另算 10 和 20 条/年敏感性。时间近似分年用于 bootstrap，属于假设，不应称为数据原有的独立年份。
- STORM present-climate IBTrACS v4（不是有重复轨迹的 v2），北大西洋 10 个 1,000 年文件、实际原始风暴 107,063 条，500 km 预筛进入 33,930 条、风场异常 0；以文件内原年份及文件序号组成 10,000 模拟年。版本依据 4TU 页及 Bloemendaal et al. 2020 [3][10]。
- 相同 19 站冻结经纬度，轨迹节点间 15 min 插值，生命周期站点峰值、最终中心距 ≤300 km；CLIMADA 6.1.0 H08，POCI=1010 hPa，另算 1005/1015 hPa。`radius_max_wind` 入 H08 为海里：RAFT 原始海里直接传入，STORM km 除以 1.852；修复记录在，源码 [8]。输入轨迹 `vmax` 的 10 min/1 min 换算只作定义留痕，不是本 H08 主链的直接输入。
- H08 海面 1 min 风转成 10 m、开阔地貌 z0=0.03 m 的 3 s 阵风，本轮沿用 B1+B4 的总换算 1.07（作为适用性假设；参照 Simiu/NIST 的风速定义 [9]）。同一定义与同一假设同时作用两目录。ASCE 7-22 公共 `w2022_mri50w2022_mri700` ImageServer WGS84 点像元值换算 mph→m/s [4]；不使用 Liang Hu 的账号。ASCE 含非台风风风险，本链只用 TC，故与 ASCE 的误差不是纯模型误差。
- 年 block bootstrap 300 次、固定种子 20261014，图示 90% 经验分位区间。重现期绘点用原始风暴年率 + Weibull 排名插值，不拟合尾部分布，也不外推。RAFT 的 V700 仅由最高约 3 个风暴的排序确定，STORM 约 14 个；前者尾部不确定性大，bootstrap 区间未覆盖年率、POCI、模型结构不确定性。

## 冻结判据与诊断（V700）
| 判据 | 冻结门槛 | 实际 | 判定 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 闸 0：STORM 的 ASCE 有符号偏差中位 | 有效站 ≥12；绝对值 ≤20% | 19 站；−8.87% | 过 |
| 闸 1a：RAFT 的 ASCE 绝对偏差中位 | ≤15% | 30.40% | 不过 |
| 闸 1b：RAFT 相对 STORM 的绝对偏差 | RAFT ≤1.10×STORM | 30.40% 对 1.10×9.21%=10.13% | 不过 |
| 空间诊断：RAFT/STORM 相对绝对差异中位 | ≤15%，各地带有符号中位绝对值 ≤25% | 24.78%；TX–LA −32.66%，MS–Panhandle −26.70%，Peninsula–Keys −17.45%，GA–NC −27.48% | 不过 |

RAFT 对 ASCE 的 V700 地带有符号中位：TX–LA −39.57%、MS–Panhandle −36.10%、Peninsula–Keys −25.87%、GA–NC −28.34%；STORM 对应 −5.63%、−12.27%、−11.97%、−8.04%。沿岸距离 <10 km 有 13 站（RAFT/STORM 中位绝对偏差 29.51%/11.16%）；10–50 km 有 6 站（37.04%/8.16%）；>50 km 零站，不能判断这一组。19 站逐站 V50/V700、坐标、90% 区间、ASCE 比较及偏差见，图，闸原始 JSON，贡献半径与敏感性。

V50 的 ASCE 点值仅 18/19：KEYW (24.5561, −81.7596) 在官方 `w2022_mri50` 点查询返回。有可核实的官方地点值之前，不报告 KEYW 的 V50 偏差。其余 18 站 V50 中位有符号偏差 RAFT −29.1%、STORM −15.7%。

POCI 1005/1015 对 V700 的逐站相对变化中位：RAFT −6.28%/+6.05%，STORM −3.53%/+3.51%。RAFT 假设发生率 10/20 条/年时 V700 变化中位 −3.37%/+1.52%。总换算因子 1.03/1.12 相对主值 1.07 的敏感性可按整条链线性缩放而不重复运行：STORM V700 有符号偏差中位 −12.27%/−4.61%，RAFT 绝对偏差中位 33.00%/27.15%，STORM 绝对偏差中位 12.27%/7.01%；两端都不使 RAFT 过闸。这些是敏感性诊断，绝非为过闸而替换主值。最高 3/14 条风暴中贡献半径字段均存在，详情见。

## 可选第三链 SPIN，仅作描述
Gao & Xi (2026) 描述 14 NeuralGCM 成员×10 FAST 强度实现×43 年的理论输出 [5]；Zenodo v1.0.1 实际 ET 过滤文件仅 13 成员，11 组 43 年、2 组 42 年，合计 557 个成员-年、乘十次强度实现得 5,570 文件年 [6]。同一 NeuralGCM 成员-年的十个文件共用路径（首个样例经纬度一致、vmax 不同），不应视为 5,570 条独立路径。原始文本只有位置、时间、vmax，**没有 Pc/RMW**，故不能原生过 H08；探索计算额外借用 RAFT 论文 PDF 第 4 页式 2/3 的 Pc/RMW 回归 [1]。已处理 479,280 轨迹，19,065 个轨迹头步数与 ET 后数据行数不符，按预注册排除；31,903 条通过站点预筛，计算异常 0。用实际 5,570 文件年作伪年样本给出 19 站 V50/V700 描述值，V700 约 46.5–64.8 m/s；**不计入闸门、不提供年块独立置信区间、不声称 SPIN 原生设计风速**。详情见 `spin_v4_evidence.zip` 内 CSV 和。Bose et al. 2023 相关合成轨迹有论文 [7]，本轮未找到可公开直接重建的完整联合 Pc/RMW 目录，未纳入第一轮。

## 参数来源与不确定性
| 参数 | 本轮值 | 来源、查验与地位 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RAFT 轨迹数与 RMW 单位 | 40,000、RMW 海里 | 实际 NetCDF 属性、Xu et al. [1][2]；数据事实 |
| STORM v4 与 RMW 单位 | 10×1,000 年，RMW km→海里 | 4TU v4 README/文件头 [3]；数据事实及显式量纲转换 |
| 风场实现 | CLIMADA 6.1.0 H08，RMW 输入海里 | 固定源码 [8]；初版错误结果已作废 |
| 15 min、500/300 km、站点峰值 | 如上 | 预注册 的本轮算法假设；不是论文直接规定 |
| POCI | 1010 hPa；1005/1015 检验 | 预注册假设；CLIMADA 对 Pc>POCI 做裁剪，见源码 [8] |
| RAFT 年发生率 | 14.5 条/年；10/20 检验 | 未在这份公开子集找到逐轨迹模拟年定义；显式假设，年块 CI 有局限 |
| STORM 强度 10 min→1 min | 1.11（仅诊断） | STORM README 风速定义；H08 主计算不直接使用该换算的 vmax |
| 1.07 阵风/陆面换算 | 两目录相同 | 沿用本线 B1+B4，参照 [9]；假设，未用 ASCE 站点校准 |
| SPIN Pc/RMW | 借用 RAFT 两个回归式 | SPIN 数据缺这两项；跨目录模型借用，假设，第三链不得作独立闸证据 |

## 可复核材料及限定
主链脚本 、；第三链 、；独立核算。`b2_v3_evidence.zip` 保存 51 个完整 NPZ 批次、完成标记、逐站 CSV、图、闸 JSON 和详情；`spin_v4_evidence.zip` 保存第三链批次和表。 核对 40,000/107,063 原始数、16,509/33,930 入链数、全 19 站四组经验排名与 CSV 完全一致、批次无重复、区间上下界有效且包含点估计。源文件与压缩证据 SHA-256/字节数见，不能拿旧结果作结论。

## Sources
[1] https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10811331/pdf/41597_2024_Article_2952.pdf — Xu et al. 2024, RAFT（PDF 第 4 页式 2/3）
[2] https://zenodo.org/records/10392725 — RAFT 北大西洋目录
[3] https://data.4tu.nl/articles/dataset/STORM_IBTrACS_present_climate_synthetic_tropical_cyclone_tracks/12706085/4 — STORM v4
[4] https://gis.asce.org/arcgis/rest/services/ASCE722 — ASCE 7-22 公共 GIS
[5] https://gmd.copernicus.org/articles/19/7303/2026/gmd-19-7303-2026.pdf — Gao & Xi 2026, SPIN（期刊 7305–7307 页）
[6] https://zenodo.org/records/20795548 — SPIN v1.0.1 输出
[7] https://doi.org/10.1175/AIES-D-22-0060.1 — Bose, Pintar & Simiu 2023
[8] https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CLIMADA- — CLIMADA 6.1.0 H08
[9] https://www.nist.gov/publications/relation-between-saffir-simpson-hurricane-scale-wind-speeds-and-peak-3-s-gust-speeds — Simiu 2007
[10] https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-020-0381-2 — Bloemendaal et al. 2020, STORM

## 结论
第一轮闸 0 过、RAFT 增量闸及空间诊断均不过；按冻结判据，不支持当前 RAFT+H08+既定换算链继续作为“较 STORM 更接近 ASCE”的设计风速方案。差异呈广域偏低而非单站异常。若后续继续，应该另立诊断问题（RAFT 压力/半径分布、发生率和共同风场假设），而不是用本轮 ASCE 误差反调参数。V50 KEYW 官方值缺失及 3/14 条尾部支撑的局限应与结论同时保留。

## 可选第三链 SPIN，仅作描述
Gao & Xi (2026) 描述 14 NeuralGCM 成员×10 FAST 强度实现×43 年的理论输出 [5]；Zenodo v1.0.1 实际 ET 过滤文件仅 13 成员，11 组 43 年、2 组 42 年，合计 557 个成员-年、乘十次强度实现得 5,570 文件年 [6]。同一 NeuralGCM 成员-年的十个文件共用路径（首个样例经纬度一致、vmax 不同），不应视为 5,570 条独立路径。原始文本只有位置、时间、vmax，**没有 Pc/RMW**，故不能原生过 H08；探索计算额外借用 RAFT 论文 PDF 第 4 页式 2/3 的 Pc/RMW 回归 [1]。已处理 479,280 轨迹，19,065 个轨迹头步数与 ET 后数据行数不符，按预注册排除；31,903 条通过站点预筛，计算异常 0。用实际 5,570 文件年作伪年样本给出 19 站 V50/V700 描述值，V700 约 46.5–64.8 m/s；**不计入闸门、不提供年块独立置信区间、不声称 SPIN 原生设计风速**。详情见 `spin_v4_evidence.zip` 内 CSV 和。Bose et al. 2023 相关合成轨迹有论文 [7]，本轮未找到可公开直接重建的完整联合 Pc/RMW 目录，未纳入第一轮。

## 参数来源与不确定性
| 参数 | 本轮值 | 来源、查验与地位 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RAFT 轨迹数与 RMW 单位 | 40,000、RMW 海里 | 实际 NetCDF 属性、Xu et al. [1][2]；数据事实 |
| STORM v4 与 RMW 单位 | 10×1,000 年，RMW km→海里 | 4TU v4 README/文件头 [3]；数据事实及显式量纲转换 |
| 风场实现 | CLIMADA 6.1.0 H08，RMW 输入海里 | 固定源码 [8]；初版错误结果已作废 |
| 15 min、500/300 km、站点峰值 | 如上 | 预注册 的本轮算法假设；不是论文直接规定 |
| POCI | 1010 hPa；1005/1015 检验 | 预注册假设；CLIMADA 对 Pc>POCI 做裁剪，见源码 [8] |
| RAFT 年发生率 | 14.5 条/年；10/20 检验 | 未在这份公开子集找到逐轨迹模拟年定义；显式假设，年块 CI 有局限 |
| STORM 强度 10 min→1 min | 1.11（仅诊断） | STORM README 风速定义；H08 主计算不直接使用该换算的 vmax |
| 1.07 阵风/陆面换算 | 两目录相同 | 沿用本线 B1+B4，参照 [9]；假设，未用 ASCE 站点校准 |
| SPIN Pc/RMW | 借用 RAFT 两个回归式 | SPIN 数据缺这两项；跨目录模型借用，假设，第三链不得作独立闸证据 |

## 可复核材料及限定
主链脚本 、；第三链 、；独立核算。`b2_v3_evidence.zip` 保存 51 个完整 NPZ 批次、完成标记、逐站 CSV、图、闸 JSON 和详情；`spin_v4_evidence.zip` 保存第三链批次和表。 核对 40,000/107,063 原始数、16,509/33,930 入链数、全 19 站四组经验排名与 CSV 完全一致、批次无重复、区间上下界有效且包含点估计。源文件与压缩证据 SHA-256/字节数见，不能拿旧结果作结论。

## Sources
[1] https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10811331/pdf/41597_2024_Article_2952.pdf — Xu et al. 2024, RAFT（PDF 第 4 页式 2/3）
[2] https://zenodo.org/records/10392725 — RAFT 北大西洋目录
[3] https://data.4tu.nl/articles/dataset/STORM_IBTrACS_present_climate_synthetic_tropical_cyclone_tracks/12706085/4 — STORM v4
[4] https://gis.asce.org/arcgis/rest/services/ASCE722 — ASCE 7-22 公共 GIS
[5] https://gmd.copernicus.org/articles/19/7303/2026/gmd-19-7303-2026.pdf — Gao & Xi 2026, SPIN（期刊 7305–7307 页）
[6] https://zenodo.org/records/20795548 — SPIN v1.0.1 输出
[7] https://doi.org/10.1175/AIES-D-22-0060.1 — Bose, Pintar & Simiu 2023
[8] https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CLIMADA- — CLIMADA 6.1.0 H08
[9] https://www.nist.gov/publications/relation-between-saffir-simpson-hurricane-scale-wind-speeds-and-peak-3-s-gust-speeds — Simiu 2007
[10] https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-020-0381-2 — Bloemendaal et al. 2020, STORM

## 结论
第一轮闸 0 过、RAFT 增量闸及空间诊断均不过；按冻结判据，不支持当前 RAFT+H08+既定换算链继续作为“较 STORM 更接近 ASCE”的设计风速方案。差异呈广域偏低而非单站异常。若后续继续，应该另立诊断问题（RAFT 压力/半径分布、发生率和共同风场假设），而不是用本轮 ASCE 误差反调参数。V50 KEYW 官方值缺失及 3/14 条尾部支撑的局限应与结论同时保留。

items.title: B2 pre-registration v5: RAFT annual rates based primarily on observations over the same period and at the same intensity threshold
items.text:
# B2 Preregistration v5: RAFT Annual Rate Primarily Based on Contemporaneous, Same-Intensity-Threshold Observations
Time: 10-14 21:35 EDT. A decision was already made by the Lead during the earlier main-chain run, recorded here prior to reading or computing HURDAT2 annual rates and re-evaluating any station V50/V700 based thereon. Existing v1/v2/v3/v4 and the primary results with the assumed 14.5 rate are all retained as originally generated; completed station peak wind fields are not recomputed. It must not be claimed that this revision predates existing wind fields or 14.5 rate statistics, nor may definitions/thresholds be modified due to having observed ASCE comparisons.

Xu et al. (2024) PDF p. 3 Methods: synthetic initial maximum sustained wind is 33 kt (TS initiation); p. 4: terminates below 25 kt, transient events with lifetimes under 1 day deleted; intensity 10 m, 1-min. Environmental period 1979–2018 (PDF pp. 3–4); dataset year represents environmental years rather than simulation years (p. 5). Emanuel et al. (2006) supplementary material PDF p. 1 explains that genesis spatiotemporal smoothing uses historical HURDAT genesis locations, but does not provide the observed intensity screening threshold / absolute annual rate corresponding to seeds generated for this RAFT run. The RAFT official website Genesis and Track also does not provide a fixed seeding rate for this NA file. While 33 kt and exclusion under 1 day define synthetic sample qualification from Xu's main text, 33 kt cannot be called the original paper's explicit HURDAT genesis screening definition. Following the Lead's fallback instruction for "unable to find RAFT's genesis threshold", the strict main chain remains the assumed 14.5 tracks/year, with 10–20 sensitivities; forcibly aligning frequency with STORM is the primary limitation. A transparent non-primary result observational rate diagnostic is conducted separately, without redefining it post-hoc as the primary gate value.

Diagnostic calculations are fixed in advance: NHC official Atlantic HURDAT2 current version; basin AL, calendar years 1979–2018 totaling 40 years, storms assigned by year in storm ID, counted once per ID; tropical status TS/HU only, with any node 1-min vmax ≥35 kt (HURDAT2's 5 kt discretization is closest to the 33 kt initial threshold), and recorded time span from first to last tropical status TD/TS/HU ≥24 h to approximate RAFT transient elimination; non-tropical events that only reach the threshold are not counted. Counts and rates without the 24 h filter are listed as definitional sensitivity. Actual data definitions are not RAFT's native annual rate, and this diagnostic is not a validation of its annual rate. Equivalent years = 40000 / diagnostic annual rate; only existing H08 peak arrays and frozen Weibull rankings are reused, output to independent new files, and must not overwrite existing RESULTS_v1 or products_v3. If the observed rate differs from 14.5, gate comparisons are reported, but formal gates still follow the primary value.

Sources: Xu et al. 2024 doi:10.1038/s41597-024-02952-7, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10811331/pdf/41597_2024_Article_2952.pdf; Emanuel et al. 2006 supplement https://texmex.mit.edu/pub/emanuel/PAPERS/hurr_risk_suppl.pdf; NHC HURDAT2 https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/data/; RAFT official website https://raft-model.pnnl.gov/. Parameter source table: genesis spatiotemporal distribution = Emanuel 2006 supplement p. 1; RAFT initial wind 33 kt = Xu p. 3; termination 25 kt / less than one day = Xu p. 4; 35 kt with tropical status and ≥24 h used for HURDAT2 sample = observational matching proxy assumption for this round, not the paper's genesis definition; RAFT primary rate 14.5/year = existing PREREG_v1 assumption, not the authors' parameter; ERA5 1979–2018 = Xu pp. 3–4; HURDAT2 version/rate = recorded upon download.

items.text:
# B2 Preregistration v6: Correction of v5's "Threshold Not Found" Interpretation (Prior to Computing Observational Rate)
Time: 10-14 21:35 EDT. Retain v5. The Lead requested taking an observational rate with the same threshold according to RAFT's original genesis definition; Xu et al. 2024 PDF p. 3 states explicitly that "initial maximum wind speed is set to be 33 knots ... beginning of Tropical Storm designation", and p. 4 excludes lifetimes under one day; this constitutes an operational definition of the intensity threshold at synthetic sample generation, even if the cited Emanuel 2006 supplement PDF p. 1 did not explicitly state the screening rules used for the historical genesis location kernel. Therefore, this round adopts the 1979–2018 annual average from HURDAT2 over the same period with TS/HU nodes ≥35 kt (HURDAT2 is discretized in 5 kt increments, closest to the model's 33 kt) and tropical lifetime ≥24 h as the **primary rate**. Annual blocks continue to be grouped using proxy sequential storm_IDs, which must be regrouped according to the new rate; 14.5 and 10–20 serve as sensitivities. Do not misrepresent the HURDAT2 rate as the RAFT seeding rate directly provided by the paper; the threshold discretization from 33 to 35 kt and lifetime calculation start are observational matching assumptions, serving as the primary methodological limitation. Only if downloaded HURDAT2 data cannot verify definitions/fields will there be a fallback to the v5 primary value with full disclosure. Return periods, gates, and everything else remain unchanged per v1–v4; this definition must not be altered based on results.

Prior to data reading, v5 equated "the threshold for the historical genesis kernel was not written out" with "the RAFT genesis threshold was not written out", which was overly conservative; this v6 prioritizes matching the 33 kt initial value from the text per the Lead's exact words as a pre-result revision. Existing primary results with the 14.5 rate cannot be falsely claimed as unrun; they are retained as the legacy baseline, and only new deliverables from this revision can be regarded as the Lead-designated primary results.

items.text:
# B2 RAFT 观测率修订：主结果（v6）
时间：10-14 21:35 EDT。对应 Lead 对年发生率的结果前决策；只重算已有 H08 站点风暴峰值的年率排序、年块区间和闸。旧 `RESULTS_v1.mdevidence_v3/products_v3/` 原样保留为 14.5 同频假设率基线，**不再是本轮主判闸版本**。 文件名已被先前的 RMW 单位修正占用，本次按顺序另写 、；v5 的过度保守门槛解释在读取观测率前被 v6 纠正。不可将此次修订称作早于旧主链结果：决定在旧结果前发出，但此执行对话实际收到并落纸晚于旧结果。本次没有根据 ASCE 调整门槛、风场或站点。

## 来源与等效年率
Xu et al. (2024) PDF 第 3 页：RAFT 合成初始 10 m 1-min 持续风 33 kt（热带风暴起始）；第 4 页：低于 25 kt 终止，少于 1 日轨迹排除；ERA5 环境期 1979–2018（第 3–4 页）。Emanuel et al. (2006) 补充材料 PDF 第 1 页：位置/季节 genesis 概率核由历史 HURDAT 生成，**未给本 RAFT 公开子集事件每年的绝对频数或历史核强度筛选标准**。据 Xu 明确的合成起始门槛，本轮以 NHC Atlantic HURDAT2 的 TS/HU、至少一个节点 ≥35 kt（5 kt 离散化后最接近 33 kt）、且热带状态 TD/TS/HU 从首到末记录间跨度 ≥24 h 匹配；以风暴 ID 年份筛 1979–2018（40 年）。这仍是**带匹配假设的观测代理率**，不是作者标定的生成种子率。HURDAT2 非热带风速不计，绝不把 `year` 环境年当 RAFT 合成年。

NHC 2026-09-23 版 SHA256，定义与原文件哈希。说明：寿命按首末热带状态跨度而非连续积分；跨年风暴归属 ID 年；这些选择可能改变率，故不把观测代理当无误差真值。

## 同链重算闸与敏感性
沿用 v3 已修复 RMW 单位的 RAFT 40,000 / STORM 107,063 原始风暴批次，19 站无换站、不重新拟合、不改 POCI、风场或 ASCE 值。按新年率重新分配 RAFT 的确定性 storm_ID 年块并以 seed=20261014 进行 300 次年块 bootstrap；STORM 保持自身 10,000 年。逐站 V50/V700、90% 区间、ASCE 和偏差；76 行 RMW 贡献；逐站 POCI 与年率敏感性。

19 站 V700 ASCE 对照完整：闸 0 STORM 中位有符号偏差 −8.87%，±20% 门槛通过；闸 1 RAFT 中位绝对偏差 **30.95%**，高于 15% 且高于 STORM 的 **9.21%**（相对门槛 10.13%），两项均不过。RAFT/STORM 空间绝对差中位 25.42%；四海岸段 RAFT 相对 STORM 有符号中位 TX–LA −34.70%、MS–狭长地带 −27.50%、佛罗里达半岛/群岛 −17.99%、GA–NC −27.96%（仅诊断）。离岸 <10 km 13 站的 RAFT/STORM 绝对偏差中位 29.90%/11.16%；10–50 km 6 站为 37.98%/8.16%；>50 km 没有站。KEYW 的 ASCE V50 公共点查询仍缺值，V700 有值；V50 对规范只能比较 18 站。V700 RAFT 范围 35.41–55.20 m/s，区间 19 站均成功。

RAFT 改用年率 10/14.5/20 场/年时，V700 相对 ASCE 的中位绝对偏差 31.48%/30.40%/29.12%，不加寿命过滤 12.225 场/年为 30.91%；均不过闸。POCI 1005/1015 相对 1010 的 V700 变化中位：RAFT −6.37%/+6.04%，STORM −3.53%/+3.51%。阵风总因子 1.03/1.12 及其原有结论沿用旧报告，本次未重新选择系数。图 注明观测代理率和来源；闸计算值。

## 范围与可复核性
这是 TC-only 与全风险 ASCE 的对比；H08 的强度、RMW/POCI、历史频率代理、年块分组和最尾端经验点均有限制。复算代码 、；后处理本地运行成功，并独立逐站核对 19 行、STORM V700 与旧主链完全相同、RAFT 区间包含点值及 RAFT 偏差中位和 JSON 一致。不曾重新启动 Colab，本次无新增 CU；旧会话已停。不使用规范账号或超算。

来源：Xu et al. 2024 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-02952-7 （PDF 第 3–5 页）；Emanuel et al. 2006 supplement https://texmex.mit.edu/pub/emanuel/PAPERS/hurr_risk_suppl.pdf （PDF 第 1 页）；NHC HURDAT2 https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/data/hurdat/hurdat2-1851-2025-092326.txt；ASCE 7-22 GIS https://gis.asce.org/arcgis/rest/services/ASCE722。

## 一句话判定
在 Lead 指定的同期同门槛观测年率代理下，STORM 闸 0 通过，RAFT 闸 1 仍不过且更偏低；该链目前不值得按“比传统目录更接近 ASCE”的设计风速方案继续，不以这轮误差反调年率。

# B2 Kickoff and Criteria Freezing (2026-10-14 19:20, B2 Node Lead)

## Decisions
1. Unify comparison specifications: station at 10 m, open terrain z0=0.03 m, 3 s gust (ASCE Exposure C); all stations treated uniformly as open terrain, with no directional exposure corrections. Basis: Vickery et al. 2010 ASCE-7 ultimate wind speeds based on 10 m open terrain peak gust (Zotero GPEGNRXQ, PDF p. 8 / journal p. 620); ASCE 7-22 card (specific page numbers pending verification).
2. Add **Gate 0** before the proposed criteria in the task assignment: STORM chain V700 median deviation relative to ASCE within ±20%, otherwise deemed "wind field / conversion chain non-compliant" and AI will not be evaluated. Reason: Lessons from B1+B4—when the chain itself is biased, AI comparisons are dominated by input assumptions (verdict). No literature basis, based on data from this track.
3. **Gate 1** follows task assignment: RAFT median absolute deviation ≤15% and ≤1.1×STORM. V50, HURDAT2, SPIN/Bose catalogs reported only and do not enter gates.
4. Stations frozen at 19 ASOS airport stations (KBRO…KHSE, see project page).
5. Return periods use empirical percentiles (Weibull plotting), without fitting distributions; STORM 10,000 years (Bloemendaal 2020 wind speed probability paper PDF p. 8, Zotero UKPE6ZD3).
6. Round 1 assigned to ideas; five sources + Vickery 2010 commissioned to litwiki for card creation; Deep Research monthly quota exhausted, step 2 pending recovery.

## Cost of Being Wrong
If Gate 0 is too strict, "the AI catalog is actually usable" might be misjudged as a chain issue and Shelved; however, Gate 0 only requires ±20% for the STORM chain, and failure to pass would inherently indicate issues in conversion or wind field, rendering results uninterpretable. Re-running requires only modifying the wind field or conversion recorded as v2, with data extraction and scripts reusable.

## Supplement (10-14 19:22, decided by Parent Project Lead)
- Criteria and stations downgraded to draft, to be frozen after receiving replies from the lines queried by the parent project; before freezing, ideas will not extract ASCE values or output comparative numbers, but may perform data retrieval, parameter verification, and wind field run-throughs. The content of original items 1–5 remains unchanged, only shifting the "freezing" point in time.
- Add stratified reporting (report only, does not enter gates): exceedance contributions by track distance to station <1, 1–3, >3 times RMW; stations by offshore distance <10, 10–50, >50 km. Basis: H node (H08 outer perimeter is high by ~+2.5 m/s, underestimates near core), without literature basis, based on data from this track.

## Supplement 2 (10-14 19:25, frozen after both tracks replied)
- Both EVA and Design Load tracks replied: no duplication, no station ASCE 7-22 values or hurricane catalogs available to borrow. Criteria and 19 stations frozen immediately.
- Added ex-ante rule: ASCE values obtained only via public channels, without reading maps; if ≥12 stations are obtained, judge Gate 0/Gate 1 as usual; if <12 stations, downgrade to a relative comparison of RAFT vs. STORM (median absolute difference ≤15% and each coastal segment ≤±25%), and conclusions must not be written as equivalent to design wind speeds. The 12-station threshold has no literature basis, set by "over half and roughly covering the four segments".
- Design Load track materials are read-only, citing only conclusions and paths; without modifying their calculators or referencing their "B2/C0" numerical deliverables.
- Cost of being wrong: If the 12-station threshold or the ±25% segment threshold is unsuitable, it only affects the degraded assessment method when data retrieval is incomplete; modifications recorded as v2.

## Supplement 3 (10-14 20:35): Dimension Corrections and Gate Assessment Versions
- Decision I made: Accept ideas' PREREG_v3 (RMW dimension correction, first 6 batches invalidated, Pc>POCI clipped per CLIMADA defaults), because both are errors identified from source code inspection and occurred before any station statistics and gate evaluations (CLIMADA 6.1.0 `tctrack_to_si` lines 1322–1332, verified by ideas); gate evaluation will be based on the subsequent PREREG version containing contemporaneous HURDAT2 annual rates (decided at 19:54).
- Verification: RMW for B1+B4 chain comes from ATCF B-deck column 20, native units in nautical miles, passed directly ( line 59, line 41), unaffected by this error.
- ASCE 7-22 V700 public GIS acquired all 19/19 stations → judge Gate 0/Gate 1 as usual, without triggering relative comparison rules.
- Cost of being wrong: If the v3 correction itself is flawed, only postprocessing needs to be rerun (a few Colab CUs), with old results retained. No literature basis, based on source code and data from this track.

## Supplement 4 (10-14 21:40): Round 1 Gate Evaluation and Proposed Shelving
- Result: Gate 0 passed (STORM V700 median −8.87% relative to ASCE 7-22, 19/19 stations); Gate 1 failed (RAFT 30.40% > 15%, and > 1.1×9.21%). The direction is consistent with RAFT authors' self-report (Rmax on average ~19% lower, landfall 99th-percentile winds ~8 kt lower, card PDF pp. 6–7).
- Decision I made: Propose to be Shelved according to frozen criteria, without tuning parameters or rescuing the gate; abandoning a track is subject to mandatory review, already submitted (count 6), status to be determined after verdict. Cost of being wrong: If review reveals implementation errors, rerun takes ~9 CU.
- 21:50 update: Annual rate changed per 19:54 decision to use HURDAT2 observational proxy of 12.075 storms/year (PREREG_v6) as the primary version for gate evaluation; RAFT at 30.95% still fails; annual rate sensitivity 29–31%, no change in judgment. v6 put to paper later than the 14.5 version results, already noted.

# B2 重启前置诊断 v1：仅目录输入对观测，不触碰设计规范

时间：10-14 23:20 EDT。结论为输入链诊断，不是设计风速的复判或可发表科学结论。原产品与预注册不变。本目录只新增诊断文件；未重算 V50/V700、未调用任何规范站点数值、未上超算。数据与计算来源：RAFT / Xu 等（卡，PDF 第 2、4–5、8 页）[2]；NHC HURDAT2 与 CIRA EBTRK v3.0.2 [3][4]；CLIMADA 6.1.0 固定源码 [5]。

## 口径和可复核性

冻结 19 个站点仅使用 含逐点关联与缺失标记。

RAFT 原目录 40,000 条、入 500 km 的有效轨迹 15,063 条；STORM v4 原 107,063 条、入样 32,016 条。输入统计为有效轨迹中 ≥35 kt 原生过程点：RAFT 115,613、STORM 338,599、观测 1,515；原始节点时间间隔分别为 6 h、3 h、6 h，故节点分布会按持续时间加权，不是按独立风暴或模拟年加权。STORM 的 10-min `vmax` 乘原链的假设 1.11 才与 RAFT/HURDAT 1-min kt 分层；此系数未用规范误差校准[1][2]。Pc 为 hPa，ΔP=max(0,1010−Pc) hPa，RMW 单位海里。POCI=1010 hPa 是沿用原链的假设，并非两目录或观测逐时给出；其范围检查仍应按原预注册 1005–1015 hPa。[1][2][5]

### 三方输入分布（仅 TS+；p50 / p90 / p99）

## 固定风场链的配对输入替换

对相同合成风暴、同 19 站、同 CLIMADA 6.1.0 H08、15-min 插值、POCI=1010、300-km 风场截断和原 1.07 总换算，分别替换 Pc、RMW、两者，不改其他变量。Pc 替换来自上述同期近岸 HURDAT2 的 1,515 节点二次最小二乘拟合：`Pc(hPa)=1030.4386−0.6978157 V−0.0006672165 V²`（V 为 1-min kt）；拟合范围 35–150 kt，范围外计算用端点裁剪，这是诊断假设而非原论文参数。RAFT 原式 `Pc=1030.222−0.730 V`（Xu 2024 PDF 第 4 页式 2）[1]。把拟合截距称作环境气压是错误的；本链的 POCI 仍单独取 1010。

RMW 替换从同一观测 1,305 正值，按 20-kt 风速箱（±10 kt）×纬度区间 <25/25–35/≥35° 的条件经验分布抽样；池 <20 点则依次扩到全纬度 ±15、±30 kt、最后全体，SHA256(风暴 ID、节点号、固定种子 20261014) 固定抽取。四变体共用每个风暴的同一位置与时序；STORM 亦同样替换作对照。注意：逐节点独立抽取会令 RMW 沿轨非物理跳变，因而 RMW 效应（尤其外围/弱风和 p99）**仅作探索，可能受跳变放大，不能据此冻结修正参数**。这不是作者规定的抽样口径，而是显式诊断假设；合理范围待做事件内相关保持与条件池宽度敏感性。[3][4]

事件选择为 `SHA256(事件) mod 20 <1` 的确定性约 5% 样本（RAFT 738、STORM 1,613 条，合计 2,351）。每目录使用同一组被选事件四变体配对；19 站各有同数单场峰值，包括 300 km 截断造成的 0。旧 0.5% 小样结果保留在，本报告用扩大样本；扩大是在发现单站正风样本过少后进行，并非预注册统计检验，p99 仍仅描述。对新增 5% 样本 2,351 个事件×19 站基线对照原封存主链，44,669 条站点峰值最大绝对差 0.00000334 m/s，故这确实是同一 H08 链，不是近似解析替代。[5]

逐站 p50/p90/p99、配对变化与零值率见 、；图 标注来源和“不是重现期风速”。RAFT Pc-only 在受影响站点×事件的中位变化很小；RMW-only 对中等风影响大，但 STORM 在同样替换下也有大变化，故不能称 RMW 替换“独自修好 RAFT”。更重要的是替换并未改变目录内 `vmax`、事件数、路径与年代，不能将剩余差异直接归到 AI 或发生率。

## Cat4/5 眼墙假设的直接复核

观测独立静态眼墙检验：同期近站且 EBTRK RMW 有效的 56 个 ≥114 kt 节点，固定纬度、观测 RMW 和 POCI=1010，用 CLIMADA H08 源码中的 B_s 与 Holland 静态径向风公式在 r=RMW 处分别输入观测 Pc 与 RAFT 线性式 Pc；将气压趋势和移速置零作为**静态受控测试**（源码 [5] 第 364–435、701–747 行）。RAFT 式相对观测 Pc 的中位偏高 3.62 hPa，静态眼墙风中位损失 2.87%，节点损失的 p10–p90 为 −5.77%～12.83%；不是普遍的 10–15%。

实际完整 H08 链的强风暴测试：在 5% 合成样本中以沿轨最大 vmax≥114 kt 标为 Cat4/5，而不是以站点峰值倒推强度。RAFT 有 70 条此类风暴在 19 站产出 317 条基线>5 的站点×事件；只换观测拟合 Pc，配对峰值中位 +1.84%（p10–p90 −1.53%～+3.80%）。限制为基线>25 m/s 时，39 条风暴/75 条站点×事件为 +2.97%（p10–p90 +1.14%～+4.27%）。RMW-only 在 >5 子集的中位 +15.64%，但基线>25 子集仅 +2.46%，又受逐节点抽样跳变影响；STORM 同样替换后的对照在。因而“线性 Pc 式使 Cat4/5 眼墙风普遍损失 10–15%”在此观测拟合与受控链下不成立；它不能解释整条目录的输入尾部差异。此处正负号均定义为替换后相对原始 H08 的变化，不是对工程标准的偏差。[1][3][4][5]

## 直接用 vmax 的 CLIMADA 6.1.0 实现

固定源码 （上游 URL [5]）：`MODEL_VANGmodel_kwargs={'vmax_from_cen': False}`，第 307–308 行调用 `_B_holland_1980`，第 503–508 行该 B 来自目录 vmax 与 ΔP；默认 True 则在第 304–306 行根据 Pc **覆盖**目录 vmax，不能作为“直接用 AI vmax”的候选。转换函数第 1297–1346 行显示 vmax、Pc、RMW 仍均需提供（RMW 输入海里，中心压强不高于环境压强）。H10 非“完全不要 Pc”，但非默认模式确实让目录 vmax 进入剖面；目前仅源码核实与小型 H08 pilot，**没有运行 H10 对观测的资格验证**，不得宣称它会改善结果。[5]

## 参数来源、局限与下一步

| 参数/处理 | 值或规则 | 溯源/性质 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 观测期、强度 | 1988–2018、TS/HU≥35 kt、距冻结站 ≤500 km | 与 EBTRK 重叠，按源文件同一风暴 ID/UTC；诊断抽样条件[3][4] |
| RAFT Pc、RMW | 原式 hPa、nmi；6 h | Xu 2024 PDF 第 4 页式 2–3；卡 NR_xu_2024_raft.md[1] |
| STORM Pc、RMW、vmax | hPa、km、m/s 10-min；3 h；RMW 除 1.852 | Bloemendaal 2020 PDF 第 2、5、8 页；卡 KHFQRECZ[2] |
| POCI、换算 | 1010 hPa、1.07、STORM vmax×1.11 | 旧 PREREG 假设；不从本站观测或工程标准重新求优 |
| Pc 替换 | 观测二次拟合；35–150 kt 外端点裁剪 | 本轮 1,515 节点的经验诊断；外推/曲线族均是假设 |
| RMW 替换 | 条件经验池与逐节点固定随机数 | 本轮假设；时间不连续，不能作生产性修正 |
| 事件入样 | SHA256(event) mod 20<1 | 5% 描述性样本；无随机重复或置信区间，不能推至 V50/V700 |
| 海陆分档 | 合成 Natural Earth 1:10m land；观测 EBTRK signed land distance | 不同参考海岸线；前者只二值海/陆，不报精确 <10/10–50/>50 km |

**可预注册的修正：现在没有。** 观测条件 Pc 替换仅引起有限强风提升，RMW 效应受时间不连续抽样污染，STORM 同样受它显著影响；更上游的强度尾部与目录路径/频率未通过本次单因素替换分离。下一轮如要探索可先另写 PREREG：①保留原闸 0/闸 1 的门槛与冻结 19 站，不得删站、改阈值；②仅用本轮观测输入检验来预先选择一个直接用 vmax 的模型（候选 H10 `vmax_from_cen=False`）并先验证单位、眼墙/外围表现，Pc 与 RMW 采用明确来源、时间连续的观测条件规则；③锁定后才可在新运行根上重跑目录对比，并把是否改进作为待验证问题。绝不可依据任何规范比对值拟合 Pc、RMW 或选择风场模型。当前 B2 状态继续搁置。

文件：（主输入表）、脚本及。原始压缩证据 `diag5_output.zip`；诊断不会替代旧产品。Colab CPU 作业完成且会话已 `stop`；账户有其他活跃会话，不能精确归因共享账户的 CU 变化，本任务自身未见 >5 CU 的迹象。

## Sources

[1] https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-024-02952-7.pdf — Xu et al. 2024 RAFT
[2] https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-020-0381-2 — Bloemendaal et al. 2020 STORM
[3] https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/data/hurdat/hurdat2-1851-2025-092326.txt — NHC HURDAT2 Atlantic
[4] https://rammb2.cira.colostate.edu/wp- — CIRA EBTRK v3.0.2 README
[5] https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CLIMADA- — CLIMADA 6.1.0 source

items.title: B2 shelving verdict (6/6 valid: Gemini, GPT-6, GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, Grok; no substitutions)
items.text:
# B2 Shelved Verdict (6/6 Valid: Gemini, GPT-6, GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, Grok; No Alternates)
Time: 10-14 22:30. Verdict issuer: B2 Node Lead. Only one round reviewed.

**Conclusion: 6/6 support Shelved (2 without reservation, 4 "support with reservations", reservations are all wording issues, not involving determination). B2 status changed to 'Shelved'.**
Gate assessment primary version = v6 (RAFT annual rate uses HURDAT2 observational proxy 12.075 events/year): Gate 0 passed (STORM V700 median −8.87%, 19/19 stations); Gate 1 failed (RAFT median absolute bias 30.95%, >15% and >1.1×9.21%=10.13%) (Lead personally read values and verified).

## Must Change (Implemented)
1. Primary figure uses v6's 30.95%, with 14.5 version's 30.40% only as sensitivity (A, D, C, B, F). → Project page, decision, track status updated.
2. Source for "14.5 events/year" was misstated: it is not the STORM North Atlantic value, North Atlantic λ = 10.8 (card KHFQRECZ PDF page 4, Lead checked card line 11) (E; consistent with ideas v7 correction). → Parameter source table updated, see below for RESULTS_v1 errata.
3. RAFT/STORM relative comparison (24.78%, four segments ±25%) is only activated when ASCE < 12 stations, 19/19 in this round, **not a failed gate**, only a diagnostic (A, B, F). → Errata.
4. Disclosure: The "year-block annual exceedance" check promised in PREREG_v1 was not output in post-processing (E independently recalculated using NPZ, V700 median matched primary estimate to two decimal places, RAFT −30.40%/STORM −8.87%); `invalid` count mixed 500 km pre-screening with invalid nodes, so the expression "500 km pre-screened entries" was inaccurate (E, A). Station wind speeds unaffected (500 km is far greater than H08 cutoff of 300 km). → Errata.
5. Attribution phrasing: **Must not write "implementation error", nor write as "30% has been explained by author self-reported bias"**. State as: the common pipeline is controlled by STORM passing Gate 0; no errors explaining 30% were found in units, H08 inputs, plotting, or annual rate year assignment (D, C, B, F downloaded CLIMADA 6.1.0 source code to check: `tctrack_to_si` lines 1322–1332; H08 only uses pressure deficit, does not read catalog vmax); the underestimation is distributional overall (V50 supported by ~55 storms per station is also low at −29.1%, not just the tail); whether it specifically stems from the catalog's Pc–vmax empirical formula, Rmax regression, nearshore decay, or shared assumptions (POCI = 1010, annual rate proxy, 1.07 conversion), **has not been quantitatively separated in this round**; author self-reporting (Rmax low by ~19%, landfall 99th percentile low by ~8 kt, card NR_xu_2024_raft PDF pages 6–7) serves only as directional clues.
 - Add an important qualification (C, E): H08 does not use vmax, so this pipeline actually tests **RAFT's Pc/Rmax given by empirical formulas**, not RAFT's MLP intensity itself. The conclusion cannot be written as "negating RAFT's AI intensity model".

## For Reference Only
- E: RAFT's linear formula Pc = 1030.222 − 0.730·vmax coupled with pure-pressure H08 with POCI = 1010 results in ~10–15% wind speed loss at the intense hurricane end (Cat4/5 calculation example); even if taking the 1st maximum out of 40,000 tracks per station, the median bias is still 22.2%. Not recalculated by Lead, serves as the first hypothesis for restart diagnosis.
- B: RAFT's near-station storms entering 500 km average 5.98 events/year, higher than STORM's 3.39 events, so frequency is not the source of underestimation.
- Year numbers in `run_catalog_v3.py:92` overwritten by post-processing, dead code (E, A, D, C, B, F).
- V700 interpolates between ranks 3–4, but RAFT 90% interval upper bounds across all 19 stations are below ASCE (minimum gap 10.9%, F); thin tail does not change the verdict.
- Raw NetCDF unit attributes were not exported for audit (A, F, C could not verify); order-of-magnitude Pa/hPa error is inconsistent with 35–65 m/s peaks, does not block Shelved.

## Dissenting Opinions Not Adopted
- F: "Diagnosing Pc/Rmax first cannot be written as a restart condition; it can only be written as 'after modification, Gate 1 passes and Gate 0 still passes'". Partially adopted: diagnosis is written as **prerequisite work before restart** rather than a trigger; the **trigger** remains "after re-preregistration under the same frozen thresholds, Gate 1 passes and Gate 0 still passes". Reason: without diagnosis there are no preregisterable modifications; the "backdoor" F worried about is closed by "the same thresholds, not reverse-tuning against ASCE errors".
- E: "H08 interface mismatch must be written as the primary shelving reason". Not adopted as conclusion (classified into for reference only): its 10–15% magnitude has not been recalculated, and conflicts with opinions of A, B, F on "no quantitative attribution"; written as the primary hypothesis to be diagnosed.

## Shelving Reasons and Restart Conditions (Written to Project Page)
See "Current Status".
Basis: Pipeline data (gates.json, return_levels.csv, details.json); literature cards NR_xu_2024_raft (PDF pages 4, 6–7), KHFQRECZ (PDF page 4).

## Addendum (10-14 23:30): Prerequisite Diagnosis v1 Conclusions and Final Step
- Diagnosis v1: Replacing Pc alone yields a median of 0.0% on affected station peaks, Cat4/5 +1.84%; replacing RMW alone yields a median of +4.2% (same replacement on STORM +16.7%, sampling has jumps). Reviewer E's "linear Pc formula loses 10–15%" does not hold. No preregisterable modifications → do not draft restart PREREG, B2 remains Shelved.
- Decision I made: Dispatch one final step (near-station intense storm passage frequency RAFT/STORM vs. HURDAT2, using only observations, 0 SU) to separate remaining differences between "passage frequency" and "passage intensity", completing closure — because this is critical to deciding "whether switching to a vmax-driven wind field (H10) is worthwhile": if the main factor is frequency/track, switching the wind field model cannot save it either — cost of being wrong: one round of local computation in ideas. No literature basis, based on pipeline data.

## Addendum (10-15 00:10): Attribution Closure
- Passage diagnosis: For Cat3+ passages per thousand storms within 100 km, Gulf of Mexico two segments RAFT 0.09/0.17, STORM 1.04/1.45, HURDAT2 1979–2018 3.45/4.14; Florida peninsula 1.97/2.55/2.07. RAFT nearshore intensity tail is the primary factor; direction is consistent with author self-reporting "nearshore intensity is weak, landfall decay is fast" (card NR_xu_2024_raft PDF pages 6–7), magnitude is pipeline data.
- Decision I made: B2 closed, status remains 'Shelved'; do not draft H10 restart preregistration (vmax itself is weak nearshore, switching wind field models cannot rescue it); restart condition changed to "new AI catalog must first pass near-station Cat3+ passage rate screening". Cost of being wrong: if H10 actually brings improvement, discovering it one step later; screening table and scripts both exist, retry cost 0 SU.
- Deleted ~790 MB of downloaded copies of public raw data on Workstation (RAFT/STORM, not results, hashes and re-retrieval scripts retained), due to drive C at 98%, and Liang Hu on 10-14 ruled that Workstation does not store computational data.

- Raw NetCDF unit attributes were not exported for audit (A, F, C could not verify); order-of-magnitude Pa/hPa error is inconsistent with 35–65 m/s peaks, does not block Shelved.

## Dissenting Opinions Not Adopted
- F: "Diagnosing Pc/Rmax first cannot be written as a restart condition; it can only be written as 'after modification, Gate 1 passes and Gate 0 still passes'". Partially adopted: diagnosis is written as **prerequisite work before restart** rather than a trigger; the **trigger** remains "after re-preregistration under the same frozen thresholds, Gate 1 passes and Gate 0 still passes". Reason: without diagnosis there are no preregisterable modifications; the "backdoor" F worried about is closed by "the same thresholds, not reverse-tuning against ASCE errors".
- E: "H08 interface mismatch must be written as the primary shelving reason". Not adopted as conclusion (classified into for reference only): its 10–15% magnitude has not been recalculated, and conflicts with opinions of A, B, F on "no quantitative attribution"; written as the primary hypothesis to be diagnosed.

## Shelving Reasons and Restart Conditions (Written to Project Page)
See "Current Status".
Basis: Pipeline data (gates.json, return_levels.csv, details.json); literature cards NR_xu_2024_raft (PDF pages 4, 6–7), KHFQRECZ (PDF page 4).

## Addendum (10-14 23:30): Prerequisite Diagnosis v1 Conclusions and Final Step
- Diagnosis v1: Replacing Pc alone yields a median of 0.0% on affected station peaks, Cat4/5 +1.84%; replacing RMW alone yields a median of +4.2% (same replacement on STORM +16.7%, sampling has jumps). Reviewer E's "linear Pc formula loses 10–15%" does not hold. No preregisterable modifications → do not draft restart PREREG, B2 remains Shelved.
- Decision I made: Dispatch one final step (near-station intense storm passage frequency RAFT/STORM vs. HURDAT2, using only observations, 0 SU) to separate remaining differences between "passage frequency" and "passage intensity", completing closure — because this is critical to deciding "whether switching to a vmax-driven wind field (H10) is worthwhile": if the main factor is frequency/track, switching the wind field model cannot save it either — cost of being wrong: one round of local computation in ideas. No literature basis, based on pipeline data.

## Addendum (10-15 00:10): Attribution Closure
- Passage diagnosis: For Cat3+ passages per thousand storms within 100 km, Gulf of Mexico two segments RAFT 0.09/0.17, STORM 1.04/1.45, HURDAT2 1979–2018 3.45/4.14; Florida peninsula 1.97/2.55/2.07. RAFT nearshore intensity tail is the primary factor; direction is consistent with author self-reporting "nearshore intensity is weak, landfall decay is fast" (card NR_xu_2024_raft PDF pages 6–7), magnitude is pipeline data.
- Decision I made: B2 closed, status remains 'Shelved'; do not draft H10 restart preregistration (vmax itself is weak nearshore, switching wind field models cannot rescue it); restart condition changed to "new AI catalog must first pass near-station Cat3+ passage rate screening". Cost of being wrong: if H10 actually brings improvement, discovering it one step later; screening table and scripts both exist, retry cost 0 SU.
- Deleted ~790 MB of downloaded copies of public raw data on Workstation (RAFT/STORM, not results, hashes and re-retrieval scripts retained), due to drive C at 98%, and Liang Hu on 10-14 ruled that Workstation does not store computational data.

results.title: B2 round 1 pre-registration v1 (frozen before computing any station wind speed)
results.text:
# B2 Round 1 Preregistration v1 (Frozen Before Computing Any Station Wind Speeds)
Time: 10-14 20:02 EDT. Criteria and 19 stations are from the 10-14 19:25 frozen version. This document will not be modified hereafter; if pre-checks reveal that the data structure is non-executable, a separate v2 will be established, preserving this document. Parameters must not be tuned against ASCE values.

## Cohort, Definitions, and Workflow
RAFT uses only Zenodo 10392725 40,000 tracks; STORM uses only the 4TU present-climate IBTrACS version 2 (12706085/2) North Atlantic ten 1,000-year files, totaling 10,000 years. Strictly preserve original catalog storm intensity, track, and RMW; exclude missing/unphysical nodes (Pc<=0, RMW<=0, POCI<=Pc), but do not delete storms based on results. Both catalogs are linearly interpolated between track nodes to 15 min (no extrapolation), with longitudes first handled for dateline crossings; for the same station, take the peak 3 s gust over the entire lifecycle of each storm. Screening: Storms whose original nodes are >500 km from all 19 stations can be omitted, but the nearest distance along track segments (including segments passing near stations) must be checked, and the number screened out must be reported; finally, H08 takes only center distances <=300 km (following B1+B4 v1). The zero wind field at the first node is a CLIMADA implementation detail, no need to extrapolate endpoints. The gate must not be altered by selecting more favorable times, radii, or stations.

Wind field uses the identical CLIMADA 6.1.0 tag commit `bb9595944fcf673152ea53e61efbafeb0b1e4406` H08 `_compute_windfields` and `tctrack_to_si`. Input raw RMW; CLIMADA H08 computes wind using Pc, POCI, RMW, and translational speed, **and does not use track vmax to determine H08 wind speed** (source code lines 205–246, 1297–1330). Therefore, STORM's 10-min→1-min = 1.11 is used only for input definition recordkeeping/diagnostics and does not alter the main calculation results; it must not be claimed that the original maximum winds of the two catalogs are identical. POCI is not provided in track files of either catalog; fixed assumption of 1010 hPa, with sensitivity at 1005/1015 hPa. Winds generated by CLIMADA are understood on a 10 m open water 1 min baseline.

Logarithmic layer from sea surface to open terrain from B1+B4 v1: F=[ln(10/.03)/ln(500/.03)]/[ln(10/.0013)/ln(500/.0013)], applied uniformly to all stations (no directional terrain sampling); surface z0=0.03 m, sea surface z0=0.0013 m, with 500 m as the assumed reference height, sensitivity 200/1000 m. The 3 s open terrain gust takes **a total factor of 1.07 on the sea surface 1 min baseline** (Simiu et al. 2007 PDF pp. 1–3 / Table 1: 10 m open water 1 min → 10 m open terrain 3 s); thus, sea surface 1 min wind is first multiplied by F, and then multiplied by 1.07/F (i.e., net multiplication by 1.07); this formulation guarantees no double-counting of roughness. Sensitivity is performed for total factors 1.03/1.12; additionally, note on the relationship between F and the accompanying gust factor under reference heights of 200/1000 m: as long as the literature total factor is held fixed, F cancels out, and varying F cannot be treated as an independent physical sensitivity. This coefficient applies only to tropical cyclones and is not transferred to thunderstorm / mixed climates.

## Annual Rate, Return Period, and Uncertainty
STORM specifies 10,000 synthetic years, using in-file year + file sequence number to form global years; storm-free years are retained in the total year count. In RAFT data, `year` is a randomly sampled ERA5 environmental year 1979–2018, not a simulation year; neither the paper nor Zenodo provides the equivalent number of years. **Assume** that RAFT's annual occurrence rate is the same as STORM's North Atlantic present-climate 14.5 storms/year (Bloemendaal et al. 2020 Sci Data PDF Table 3 / corresponding storm count, requiring page-by-page verification), RAFT equivalent years = 40000/14.5; sensitivity 10–20 storms/year. For year-block bootstrap, storms will be grouped by fixed storm_ID order into contiguous synthetic year blocks of 14/15 events (deterministic, uniform allocation; not treating ERA5 years as independent years); this is a proxy sampling that does not capture shared environmental year correlations. The primary estimate ranks storm peaks per station, annual exceedance rate λ(v) = number of storm peaks exceeding v / equivalent years; Weibull plotting: using the k-th value from largest to smallest, with k/(Nstorm+1)×Nstorm/Nyear, perform **linear interpolation of wind speed** between adjacent points for the target 1/T, with out-of-range values not extrapolated and recorded as missing; zero-storm wind speeds are not added to the ranking but retain equivalent years. An annual block having any storm exceeding the threshold serves as an additional check for annual exceedance and must not be conflated with λ. Block bootstrap with replacement 300 times, fixed RNG seed=20261014, 90% percentile interval; if target tail samples are insufficient, use null, do not fit the tail.

Gate 0: When ASCE values are obtained for >=12 stations, the station median of STORM V700/ASCE V700-1 is within ±20%. If failed, AI is not evaluated. Gate 1: After passing Gate 0, RAFT station V700 median absolute deviation relative to ASCE is <=15%, and <=1.1× the same metric for STORM. If ASCE has fewer than 12 stations, Gates 0/1 are not evaluated, and only the relative comparison predetermined on the project page is conducted: RAFT vs STORM V700 station median absolute difference <=15%, and median signed differences across all four predetermined coastal segments are all <=25% in absolute value. If any of the four segments has no valid stations, it must not be claimed to pass. V50 is reported only.

19 stations original order: KBRO KCRP KGLS KLCH KMSY KGPT KMOB KPNS KAAF KTPA KRSW KEYW KMIA KPBI KMLB KJAX KCHS KILM KHSE. Exact coordinates according to IEM ASOS station table; four coastal segments follow the project page geographic order: first 5 / next 4 (KGPT–KAAF) / next 6 (KTPA–KMLB) / next 4 (KJAX–KHSE); spherical approximate shortest distance from each station to Natural Earth 10m coastline categorized into <10, 10–50, >50 km (offshore sea points also take absolute distance, without adjusting speeds based on this). At the V50/V700 level, using storms with peak >= return period level as the denominator, the ratio of center distance at peak time / then-current RMW is categorized into <1, 1–3, >3 bins, with exact boundary 1 entering 1–3, and 3 entering >3; report counts/proportions, exclude missing RMW and report the count. NA / zero denominators must not impersonate 0.

ASCE 7-22 50/700 MRI values are retrieved only from public location tools / GIS, retaining each station's source and raw mph value; no account used, no reading curves from standard PDFs; record missing if unavailable. The ASCE map is multi-hazard all-climate (this experiment is TC only), so discrepancies cannot be entirely attributed to wind field errors.

## Parameter Sources Table (Frozen Before Pre-check)
| Parameter | Value | Source / Status | Checked |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RAFT wind speed definition | 10 m max sustained 1 min; kt | Xu et al. 2024 Sci Data PDF pp. 3–5 Intensity/Table 1 | Original paper, Zenodo record |
| RAFT pressure/RMW | Pc=1030.222−0.730 vmax(kt), RMW=48.7 exp(0.0163637 lat−0.01450866 vmax) nmi; main chain directly reads nc raw values | Xu et al. 2024 PDF p. 4 Eqs. 2, 3 | Original paper, Zenodo fields |
| RAFT equivalent years | 40000/14.5, range 40000/10–40000/20 | **Assumption**, RAFT original text does not state equivalent years, `year` is environmental year, 14.5 events/year in STORM table is only a comparable annual rate proxy | Full original text (pp. 3–5, 9), Zenodo fields, two searches in ; subsequent code repository verification |
| STORM years / wind speed / RMW | 10,000 years; 10 m 10 min m/s, RMW km | Bloemendaal et al. 2020 Sci Data PDF pp. 2, 8 and 4TU 12706085/2 README (pending download and itemized verification) | Original paper, 4TU version/file interface |
| STORM 10 min→1 min | 1.11 (range 1.10–1.12); H08 does not read vmax so does not enter results | Powell et al. 2005 PDF pp. 5–6: marine 1 min is ~10–12% higher than 10 min; not measured for every storm | Card, CLIMADA v6.1.0 source code |
| POCI (both catalogs) | 1010 hPa, sensitivity 1005, 1015 | **Assumption**; track fields lack POCI, required by H08 | Xu 2024 PDF/Table1, Zenodo fields, STORM paper and 4TU fields, ; value must be further checked against external empirical rules, must not impersonate author's parameters |
| Sea-land log layer | z0 sea 0.0013, land 0.03 m, reference 500 m | B1+B4 lines 8–9, reference height **assumption** | Existing frozen chain |
| 1 min sea→3 s open terrain | Net multiply by 1.07, range 1.03–1.12 | Simiu et al. 2007 card |
| H08 defaults / temporal | CLIMADA 6.1.0, 15 min linear; 300 km | Model source code v6.1.0 lines 205–246, 1170–1257, 1297–1330; 15 min B1+B4 v1 line 6 | B1+B4, public source code |

## Resources and Failure Reporting
Priority to local workstation CPU, Colab CPU if necessary; pause and report to Lead if expected >100 CU; no supercomputers. Scripts, catalog lists, station peak tables, return value tables, bootstrap, stratifications, and plots each output separate new files. When data or tools cannot be obtained or statistical criteria are not met, write null and the reason, never synthesize station wind speeds or ASCE values. All relevant new external data/code registered in PUBLIC_CITATIONS.

# B2 Preregistration v3: H08 Input Unit Correction and Quarantine of Invalid Runs
Time: 10-14 20:06 EDT. Calculation results / gates have not yet been opened; v1/v2 and previous Colab , first 6 batches are retained as-is, labeled as **invalid, must not be used for conclusions**. Code inspection of CLIMADA 6.1.0 `tctrack_to_si` lines 1327–1332 revealed that `radius_max_wind` input is in **nautical miles**, and multiplied internally by 1852 to convert to meters; previous scripts mistakenly passed meters first, resulting in double conversion of RMW. The original run group has been stopped; v3 new directory recalculates RAFT/STORM, with the entire chain and criteria still following v1/v2, the sole dimensional correction being: RAFT rmax in original nautical miles is not multiplied by 1852; STORM rmax in original km is divided by 1.852 when passed in; peak distance / RMW binning only multiplies nautical miles back by 1852 m.

# B2 Optional Third Chain SPIN Preregistration Supplement v4 (Before Any Wind Speed Calculations in the Third Chain)
Time: 10-14 20:09 EDT. The main chain v3 and gates remain completely unchanged; only adds the pre-required usable third chain diagnostics. The official SPIN paper Gao & Xi (2026) GMD PDF journal pp. 7305–7307 specifies 14 NeuralGCM members, 10 FAST intensity stochastic realizations per track, theoretically 6,020 simulation years. Zenodo 20795548 v1.0.1 output is ~605 MB, already obtained; inside the archive, is the default tracks filtered by ET, is not the main input; actual file counts / missing years and correlations among the 10 realizations of the same member must be checked. Do not misreport ten intensity realizations of the same track as ten independent paths.

Its track README provides only latitude/longitude, time, and vmax (m/s), **without providing Pc/RMW/POCI**; H08 cannot be directly applied to SPIN. As a purely exploratory, non-gate "SPIN + borrowed RAFT wind-pressure and radius regressions" third chain: let vmax_kt = vmax(m/s)/0.514444; Pc(hPa) = 1030.222−0.730 vmax_kt; RMW(nmi) = 48.7 exp(0.0163637 lat −0.01450866 vmax_kt), from Xu et al. 2024 PDF p. 4 Eqs. 2/3 (not author-provided parameters for SPIN); POCI assumes 1010 hPa, 500 km screening, 15 min interpolation, CLIMADA v6.1.0 H08, 1.07 total conversion same as v3. Use only ET-filtered, actually existing complete member × year × realization files as simulation years, distinguishing "file years" from the fewer independent NeuralGCM track years; V50/V700 plotted empirically following v1, without fitting; if independent year bootstrap is not possible or qualified samples are insufficient, record null for intervals. If duplicate or missing files cannot be clarified, the third chain reports only data availability and does not fabricate calculations. The third chain does not enter gates under any circumstances, and in particular must not be called SPIN native wind field design values.

results.title: B2 round 1: RAFT/STORM same-chain design wind-speed test (completion report)
results.text:
# B2 第一轮：RAFT/STORM 同链设计风速测试（完成报告）

日期：10-14 21:30 EDT。所有结果为研究试验，不能直接作为工程设计或对外发表结论。判据在 冻结；v1–v4 的预注册勘误均保留。本报告只用修正 RMW 输入单位后的 v3 主链；旧 、 的量纲错误批次完全不参与统计。

## 一句话结果
STORM 基线闸过（19/19 有 V700；中位有符号偏差 −8.87%，门槛 ±20%）。RAFT 第一增量闸不过（中位绝对偏差 30.40%，门槛 15%，并远高于 STORM 的 9.21%）；空间相对差异中位 24.78%，超过 15% 门槛。不能按冻结闸门将 RAFT 当作比 STORM 有改进的设计风速输入，更不能调参、删站“救闸”。这是本轮链条的结果，非对 RAFT 数据或模型普适性的否定。

## 数据、风场、统计
- RAFT 北大西洋 40,000 条，原始 40,000、500 km 预筛进入 16,509 条、风场异常 0。Xu et al. 2024 的 RAFT 数据及 Zenodo 记录 [1][2]。其未明示这份 40,000 条子集的模拟总年数，因此主计算假设年发生率 14.5 条/年，等效 2,758.62 年；另算 10 和 20 条/年敏感性。时间近似分年用于 bootstrap，属于假设，不应称为数据原有的独立年份。
- STORM present-climate IBTrACS v4（不是有重复轨迹的 v2），北大西洋 10 个 1,000 年文件、实际原始风暴 107,063 条，500 km 预筛进入 33,930 条、风场异常 0；以文件内原年份及文件序号组成 10,000 模拟年。版本依据 4TU 页及 Bloemendaal et al. 2020 [3][10]。
- 相同 19 站冻结经纬度，轨迹节点间 15 min 插值，生命周期站点峰值、最终中心距 ≤300 km；CLIMADA 6.1.0 H08，POCI=1010 hPa，另算 1005/1015 hPa。`radius_max_wind` 入 H08 为海里：RAFT 原始海里直接传入，STORM km 除以 1.852；修复记录在，源码 [8]。输入轨迹 `vmax` 的 10 min/1 min 换算只作定义留痕，不是本 H08 主链的直接输入。
- H08 海面 1 min 风转成 10 m、开阔地貌 z0=0.03 m 的 3 s 阵风，本轮沿用 B1+B4 的总换算 1.07（作为适用性假设；参照 Simiu/NIST 的风速定义 [9]）。同一定义与同一假设同时作用两目录。ASCE 7-22 公共 `w2022_mri50w2022_mri700` ImageServer WGS84 点像元值换算 mph→m/s [4]；不使用 Liang Hu 的账号。ASCE 含非台风风风险，本链只用 TC，故与 ASCE 的误差不是纯模型误差。
- 年 block bootstrap 300 次、固定种子 20261014，图示 90% 经验分位区间。重现期绘点用原始风暴年率 + Weibull 排名插值，不拟合尾部分布，也不外推。RAFT 的 V700 仅由最高约 3 个风暴的排序确定，STORM 约 14 个；前者尾部不确定性大，bootstrap 区间未覆盖年率、POCI、模型结构不确定性。

## 冻结判据与诊断（V700）
| 判据 | 冻结门槛 | 实际 | 判定 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 闸 0：STORM 的 ASCE 有符号偏差中位 | 有效站 ≥12；绝对值 ≤20% | 19 站；−8.87% | 过 |
| 闸 1a：RAFT 的 ASCE 绝对偏差中位 | ≤15% | 30.40% | 不过 |
| 闸 1b：RAFT 相对 STORM 的绝对偏差 | RAFT ≤1.10×STORM | 30.40% 对 1.10×9.21%=10.13% | 不过 |
| 空间诊断：RAFT/STORM 相对绝对差异中位 | ≤15%，各地带有符号中位绝对值 ≤25% | 24.78%；TX–LA −32.66%，MS–Panhandle −26.70%，Peninsula–Keys −17.45%，GA–NC −27.48% | 不过 |

RAFT 对 ASCE 的 V700 地带有符号中位：TX–LA −39.57%、MS–Panhandle −36.10%、Peninsula–Keys −25.87%、GA–NC −28.34%；STORM 对应 −5.63%、−12.27%、−11.97%、−8.04%。沿岸距离 <10 km 有 13 站（RAFT/STORM 中位绝对偏差 29.51%/11.16%）；10–50 km 有 6 站（37.04%/8.16%）；>50 km 零站，不能判断这一组。19 站逐站 V50/V700、坐标、90% 区间、ASCE 比较及偏差见，图，闸原始 JSON，贡献半径与敏感性。

V50 的 ASCE 点值仅 18/19：KEYW (24.5561, −81.7596) 在官方 `w2022_mri50` 点查询返回。有可核实的官方地点值之前，不报告 KEYW 的 V50 偏差。其余 18 站 V50 中位有符号偏差 RAFT −29.1%、STORM −15.7%。

POCI 1005/1015 对 V700 的逐站相对变化中位：RAFT −6.28%/+6.05%，STORM −3.53%/+3.51%。RAFT 假设发生率 10/20 条/年时 V700 变化中位 −3.37%/+1.52%。总换算因子 1.03/1.12 相对主值 1.07 的敏感性可按整条链线性缩放而不重复运行：STORM V700 有符号偏差中位 −12.27%/−4.61%，RAFT 绝对偏差中位 33.00%/27.15%，STORM 绝对偏差中位 12.27%/7.01%；两端都不使 RAFT 过闸。这些是敏感性诊断，绝非为过闸而替换主值。最高 3/14 条风暴中贡献半径字段均存在，详情见。

## 可选第三链 SPIN，仅作描述
Gao & Xi (2026) 描述 14 NeuralGCM 成员×10 FAST 强度实现×43 年的理论输出 [5]；Zenodo v1.0.1 实际 ET 过滤文件仅 13 成员，11 组 43 年、2 组 42 年，合计 557 个成员-年、乘十次强度实现得 5,570 文件年 [6]。同一 NeuralGCM 成员-年的十个文件共用路径（首个样例经纬度一致、vmax 不同），不应视为 5,570 条独立路径。原始文本只有位置、时间、vmax，**没有 Pc/RMW**，故不能原生过 H08；探索计算额外借用 RAFT 论文 PDF 第 4 页式 2/3 的 Pc/RMW 回归 [1]。已处理 479,280 轨迹，19,065 个轨迹头步数与 ET 后数据行数不符，按预注册排除；31,903 条通过站点预筛，计算异常 0。用实际 5,570 文件年作伪年样本给出 19 站 V50/V700 描述值，V700 约 46.5–64.8 m/s；**不计入闸门、不提供年块独立置信区间、不声称 SPIN 原生设计风速**。详情见 `spin_v4_evidence.zip` 内 CSV 和。Bose et al. 2023 相关合成轨迹有论文 [7]，本轮未找到可公开直接重建的完整联合 Pc/RMW 目录，未纳入第一轮。

| 15 min、500/300 km、站点峰值 | 如上 | 预注册 的本轮算法假设；不是论文直接规定 |
| POCI | 1010 hPa；1005/1015 检验 | 预注册假设；CLIMADA 对 Pc>POCI 做裁剪，见源码 [8] |
| RAFT 年发生率 | 14.5 条/年；10/20 检验 | 未在这份公开子集找到逐轨迹模拟年定义；显式假设，年块 CI 有局限 |
| STORM 强度 10 min→1 min | 1.11（仅诊断） | STORM README 风速定义；H08 主计算不直接使用该换算的 vmax |

| SPIN Pc/RMW | 借用 RAFT 两个回归式 | SPIN 数据缺这两项；跨目录模型借用，假设，第三链不得作独立闸证据 |

## 可复核材料及限定
主链脚本 、；第三链 、；独立核算。`b2_v3_evidence.zip` 保存 51 个完整 NPZ 批次、完成标记、逐站 CSV、图、闸 JSON 和详情；`spin_v4_evidence.zip` 保存第三链批次和表。 核对 40,000/107,063 原始数、16,509/33,930 入链数、全 19 站四组经验排名与 CSV 完全一致、批次无重复、区间上下界有效且包含点估计。源文件与压缩证据 SHA-256/字节数见，不能拿旧结果作结论。

## 结论
第一轮闸 0 过、RAFT 增量闸及空间诊断均不过；按冻结判据，不支持当前 RAFT+H08+既定换算链继续作为“较 STORM 更接近 ASCE”的设计风速方案。差异呈广域偏低而非单站异常。若后续继续，应该另立诊断问题（RAFT 压力/半径分布、发生率和共同风场假设），而不是用本轮 ASCE 误差反调参数。V50 KEYW 官方值缺失及 3/14 条尾部支撑的局限应与结论同时保留。

# B2 第一轮：RAFT/STORM 同链设计风速测试（完成报告）

日期：10-14 21:30 EDT。交付命名 RESULTS_v1；主链方法修订至 PREREG_v3。

Colab 资源：独占本轮会话约 10-14 19:50–21:26 EDT，已 stop。观察到约 5.46 CU/小时，按 96 分钟估算约 8.74 CU；余额同期变化包含其他两个活跃会话，不能从共享总额精确归因，估计远低于 100 CU。

所有结果为研究试验，不能直接作为工程设计或对外发表结论。判据在 冻结；v1–v4 的预注册勘误均保留。本报告只用修正 RMW 输入单位后的 v3 主链；旧 、 的量纲错误批次完全不参与统计。

## 一句话结果
STORM 基线闸过（19/19 有 V700；中位有符号偏差 −8.87%，门槛 ±20%）。RAFT 第一增量闸不过（中位绝对偏差 30.40%，门槛 15%，并远高于 STORM 的 9.21%）；空间相对差异中位 24.78%，超过 15% 门槛。不能按冻结闸门将 RAFT 当作比 STORM 有改进的设计风速输入，更不能调参、删站“救闸”。这是本轮链条的结果，非对 RAFT 数据或模型普适性的否定。

## 数据、风场、统计
- RAFT 北大西洋 40,000 条，原始 40,000、500 km 预筛进入 16,509 条、风场异常 0。Xu et al. 2024 的 RAFT 数据及 Zenodo 记录 [1][2]。其未明示这份 40,000 条子集的模拟总年数，因此主计算假设年发生率 14.5 条/年，等效 2,758.62 年；另算 10 和 20 条/年敏感性。时间近似分年用于 bootstrap，属于假设，不应称为数据原有的独立年份。
- STORM present-climate IBTrACS v4（不是有重复轨迹的 v2），北大西洋 10 个 1,000 年文件、实际原始风暴 107,063 条，500 km 预筛进入 33,930 条、风场异常 0；以文件内原年份及文件序号组成 10,000 模拟年。版本依据 4TU 页及 Bloemendaal et al. 2020 [3][10]。
- 相同 19 站冻结经纬度，轨迹节点间 15 min 插值，生命周期站点峰值、最终中心距 ≤300 km；CLIMADA 6.1.0 H08，POCI=1010 hPa，另算 1005/1015 hPa。`radius_max_wind` 入 H08 为海里：RAFT 原始海里直接传入，STORM km 除以 1.852；修复记录在，源码 [8]。输入轨迹 `vmax` 的 10 min/1 min 换算只作定义留痕，不是本 H08 主链的直接输入。
- H08 海面 1 min 风转成 10 m、开阔地貌 z0=0.03 m 的 3 s 阵风，本轮沿用 B1+B4 的总换算 1.07（作为适用性假设；参照 Simiu/NIST 的风速定义 [9]）。同一定义与同一假设同时作用两目录。ASCE 7-22 公共 `w2022_mri50w2022_mri700` ImageServer WGS84 点像元值换算 mph→m/s [4]；不使用 Liang Hu 的账号。ASCE 含非台风风风险，本链只用 TC，故与 ASCE 的误差不是纯模型误差。
- 年 block bootstrap 300 次、固定种子 20261014，图示 90% 经验分位区间。重现期绘点用原始风暴年率 + Weibull 排名插值，不拟合尾部分布，也不外推。RAFT 的 V700 仅由最高约 3 个风暴的排序确定，STORM 约 14 个；前者尾部不确定性大，bootstrap 区间未覆盖年率、POCI、模型结构不确定性。

## 冻结判据与诊断（V700）

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 闸 0：STORM 的 ASCE 有符号偏差中位 | 有效站 ≥12；绝对值 ≤20% | 19 站；−8.87% | 过 |
| 闸 1a：RAFT 的 ASCE 绝对偏差中位 | ≤15% | 30.40% | 不过 |
| 闸 1b：RAFT 相对 STORM 的绝对偏差 | RAFT ≤1.10×STORM | 30.40% 对 1.10×9.21%=10.13% | 不过 |
| 空间诊断：RAFT/STORM 相对绝对差异中位 | ≤15%，各地带有符号中位绝对值 ≤25% | 24.78%；TX–LA −32.66%，MS–Panhandle −26.70%，Peninsula–Keys −17.45%，GA–NC −27.48% | 不过 |

第一轮闸 0 过、RAFT 增量闸及空间诊断均不过；按冻结判据，不支持当前 RAFT+H08+既定换算链继续作为“较 STORM 更接近 ASCE”的设计风速方案。差异呈广域偏低而非单站异常。若后续继续，应该另立诊断问题（RAFT 压力/半径分布、发生率和共同风场假设），而不是用本轮 ASCE 误差反调参数。V50 KEYW 官方值缺失及 3/14 条尾部支撑的局限应与结论同时保留。

results.text:
# B2 Preregistration v5: RAFT Annual Rate Primarily Based on Contemporaneous, Same-Intensity-Threshold Observations
Time: 10-14 21:35 EDT. A decision was already made by the Lead during the earlier main-chain run, recorded here prior to reading or computing HURDAT2 annual rates and re-evaluating any station V50/V700 based thereon. Existing v1/v2/v3/v4 and the primary results with the assumed 14.5 rate are all retained as originally generated; completed station peak wind fields are not recomputed. It must not be claimed that this revision predates existing wind fields or 14.5 rate statistics, nor may definitions/thresholds be modified due to having observed ASCE comparisons.

Xu et al. (2024) PDF p. 3 Methods: synthetic initial maximum sustained wind is 33 kt (TS initiation); p. 4: terminates below 25 kt, transient events with lifetimes under 1 day deleted; intensity 10 m, 1-min. Environmental period 1979–2018 (PDF pp. 3–4); dataset year represents environmental years rather than simulation years (p. 5). Emanuel et al. (2006) supplementary material PDF p. 1 explains that genesis spatiotemporal smoothing uses historical HURDAT genesis locations, but does not provide the observed intensity screening threshold / absolute annual rate corresponding to seeds generated for this RAFT run. The RAFT official website Genesis and Track also does not provide a fixed seeding rate for this NA file. While 33 kt and exclusion under 1 day define synthetic sample qualification from Xu's main text, 33 kt cannot be called the original paper's explicit HURDAT genesis screening definition. Following the Lead's fallback instruction for "unable to find RAFT's genesis threshold", the strict main chain remains the assumed 14.5 tracks/year, with 10–20 sensitivities; forcibly aligning frequency with STORM is the primary limitation. A transparent non-primary result observational rate diagnostic is conducted separately, without redefining it post-hoc as the primary gate value.

Diagnostic calculations are fixed in advance: NHC official Atlantic HURDAT2 current version; basin AL, calendar years 1979–2018 totaling 40 years, storms assigned by year in storm ID, counted once per ID; tropical status TS/HU only, with any node 1-min vmax ≥35 kt (HURDAT2's 5 kt discretization is closest to the 33 kt initial threshold), and recorded time span from first to last tropical status TD/TS/HU ≥24 h to approximate RAFT transient elimination; non-tropical events that only reach the threshold are not counted. Counts and rates without the 24 h filter are listed as definitional sensitivity. Actual data definitions are not RAFT's native annual rate, and this diagnostic is not a validation of its annual rate. Equivalent years = 40000 / diagnostic annual rate; only existing H08 peak arrays and frozen Weibull rankings are reused, output to independent new files, and must not overwrite existing RESULTS_v1 or products_v3. If the observed rate differs from 14.5, gate comparisons are reported, but formal gates still follow the primary value.

Sources: Xu et al. 2024 doi:10.1038/s41597-024-02952-7, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10811331/pdf/41597_2024_Article_2952.pdf; Emanuel et al. 2006 supplement https://texmex.mit.edu/pub/emanuel/PAPERS/hurr_risk_suppl.pdf; NHC HURDAT2 https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/data/; RAFT official website https://raft-model.pnnl.gov/. Parameter source table: genesis spatiotemporal distribution = Emanuel 2006 supplement p. 1; RAFT initial wind 33 kt = Xu p. 3; termination 25 kt / less than one day = Xu p. 4; 35 kt with tropical status and ≥24 h used for HURDAT2 sample = observational matching proxy assumption for this round, not the paper's genesis definition; RAFT primary rate 14.5/year = existing PREREG_v1 assumption, not the authors' parameter; ERA5 1979–2018 = Xu pp. 3–4; HURDAT2 version/rate = recorded upon download.

results.text:
# B2 Preregistration v6: Correction of v5's "Threshold Not Found" Interpretation (Prior to Computing Observational Rate)
Time: 10-14 21:35 EDT. Retain v5. The Lead requested taking an observational rate with the same threshold according to RAFT's original genesis definition; Xu et al. 2024 PDF p. 3 states explicitly that "initial maximum wind speed is set to be 33 knots ... beginning of Tropical Storm designation", and p. 4 excludes lifetimes under one day; this constitutes an operational definition of the intensity threshold at synthetic sample generation, even if the cited Emanuel 2006 supplement PDF p. 1 did not explicitly state the screening rules used for the historical genesis location kernel. Therefore, this round adopts the 1979–2018 annual average from HURDAT2 over the same period with TS/HU nodes ≥35 kt (HURDAT2 is discretized in 5 kt increments, closest to the model's 33 kt) and tropical lifetime ≥24 h as the **primary rate**. Annual blocks continue to be grouped using proxy sequential storm_IDs, which must be regrouped according to the new rate; 14.5 and 10–20 serve as sensitivities. Do not misrepresent the HURDAT2 rate as the RAFT seeding rate directly provided by the paper; the threshold discretization from 33 to 35 kt and lifetime calculation start are observational matching assumptions, serving as the primary methodological limitation. Only if downloaded HURDAT2 data cannot verify definitions/fields will there be a fallback to the v5 primary value with full disclosure. Return periods, gates, and everything else remain unchanged per v1–v4; this definition must not be altered based on results.

Prior to data reading, v5 equated "the threshold for the historical genesis kernel was not written out" with "the RAFT genesis threshold was not written out", which was overly conservative; this v6 prioritizes matching the 33 kt initial value from the text per the Lead's exact words as a pre-result revision. Existing primary results with the 14.5 rate cannot be falsely claimed as unrun; they are retained as the legacy baseline, and only new deliverables from this revision can be regarded as the Lead-designated primary results.

results.text:
# B2 RAFT 观测率修订：主结果（v6）
时间：10-14 21:35 EDT。对应 Lead 对年发生率的结果前决策；只重算已有 H08 站点风暴峰值的年率排序、年块区间和闸。旧 `RESULTS_v1.mdevidence_v3/products_v3/` 原样保留为 14.5 同频假设率基线，**不再是本轮主判闸版本**。 文件名已被先前的 RMW 单位修正占用，本次按顺序另写 、；v5 的过度保守门槛解释在读取观测率前被 v6 纠正。不可将此次修订称作早于旧主链结果：决定在旧结果前发出，但此执行对话实际收到并落纸晚于旧结果。本次没有根据 ASCE 调整门槛、风场或站点。

## 来源与等效年率
Xu et al. (2024) PDF 第 3 页：RAFT 合成初始 10 m 1-min 持续风 33 kt（热带风暴起始）；第 4 页：低于 25 kt 终止，少于 1 日轨迹排除；ERA5 环境期 1979–2018（第 3–4 页）。Emanuel et al. (2006) 补充材料 PDF 第 1 页：位置/季节 genesis 概率核由历史 HURDAT 生成，**未给本 RAFT 公开子集事件每年的绝对频数或历史核强度筛选标准**。据 Xu 明确的合成起始门槛，本轮以 NHC Atlantic HURDAT2 的 TS/HU、至少一个节点 ≥35 kt（5 kt 离散化后最接近 33 kt）、且热带状态 TD/TS/HU 从首到末记录间跨度 ≥24 h 匹配；以风暴 ID 年份筛 1979–2018（40 年）。这仍是**带匹配假设的观测代理率**，不是作者标定的生成种子率。HURDAT2 非热带风速不计，绝不把 `year` 环境年当 RAFT 合成年。

NHC 2026-09-23 版 SHA256，定义与原文件哈希。说明：寿命按首末热带状态跨度而非连续积分；跨年风暴归属 ID 年；这些选择可能改变率，故不把观测代理当无误差真值。

## 同链重算闸与敏感性
沿用 v3 已修复 RMW 单位的 RAFT 40,000 / STORM 107,063 原始风暴批次，19 站无换站、不重新拟合、不改 POCI、风场或 ASCE 值。按新年率重新分配 RAFT 的确定性 storm_ID 年块并以 seed=20261014 进行 300 次年块 bootstrap；STORM 保持自身 10,000 年。逐站 V50/V700、90% 区间、ASCE 和偏差；76 行 RMW 贡献；逐站 POCI 与年率敏感性。

19 站 V700 ASCE 对照完整：闸 0 STORM 中位有符号偏差 −8.87%，±20% 门槛通过；闸 1 RAFT 中位绝对偏差 **30.95%**，高于 15% 且高于 STORM 的 **9.21%**（相对门槛 10.13%），两项均不过。RAFT/STORM 空间绝对差中位 25.42%；四海岸段 RAFT 相对 STORM 有符号中位 TX–LA −34.70%、MS–狭长地带 −27.50%、佛罗里达半岛/群岛 −17.99%、GA–NC −27.96%（仅诊断）。离岸 <10 km 13 站的 RAFT/STORM 绝对偏差中位 29.90%/11.16%；10–50 km 6 站为 37.98%/8.16%；>50 km 没有站。KEYW 的 ASCE V50 公共点查询仍缺值，V700 有值；V50 对规范只能比较 18 站。V700 RAFT 范围 35.41–55.20 m/s，区间 19 站均成功。

RAFT 改用年率 10/14.5/20 场/年时，V700 相对 ASCE 的中位绝对偏差 31.48%/30.40%/29.12%，不加寿命过滤 12.225 场/年为 30.91%；均不过闸。POCI 1005/1015 相对 1010 的 V700 变化中位：RAFT −6.37%/+6.04%，STORM −3.53%/+3.51%。阵风总因子 1.03/1.12 及其原有结论沿用旧报告，本次未重新选择系数。图 注明观测代理率和来源；闸计算值。

## 范围与可复核性
这是 TC-only 与全风险 ASCE 的对比；H08 的强度、RMW/POCI、历史频率代理、年块分组和最尾端经验点均有限制。复算代码 、；后处理本地运行成功，并独立逐站核对 19 行、STORM V700 与旧主链完全相同、RAFT 区间包含点值及 RAFT 偏差中位和 JSON 一致。不曾重新启动 Colab，本次无新增 CU；旧会话已停。不使用规范账号或超算。

来源：Xu et al. 2024 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-02952-7 （PDF 第 3–5 页）；Emanuel et al. 2006 supplement https://texmex.mit.edu/pub/emanuel/PAPERS/hurr_risk_suppl.pdf （PDF 第 1 页）；NHC HURDAT2 https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/data/hurdat/hurdat2-1851-2025-092326.txt；ASCE 7-22 GIS https://gis.asce.org/arcgis/rest/services/ASCE722。

## 一句话判定
在 Lead 指定的同期同门槛观测年率代理下，STORM 闸 0 通过，RAFT 闸 1 仍不过且更偏低；该链目前不值得按“比传统目录更接近 ASCE”的设计风速方案继续，不以这轮误差反调年率。

## 固定风场链的配对输入替换

对相同合成风暴、同 19 站、同 CLIMADA 6.1.0 H08、15-min 插值、POCI=1010、300-km 风场截断和原 1.07 总换算，分别替换 Pc、RMW、两者，不改其他变量。Pc 替换来自上述同期近岸 HURDAT2 的 1,515 节点二次最小二乘拟合：`Pc(hPa)=1030.4386−0.6978157 V−0.0006672165 V²`（V 为 1-min kt）；拟合范围 35–150 kt，范围外计算用端点裁剪，这是诊断假设而非原论文参数。RAFT 原式 `Pc=1030.222−0.730 V`（Xu 2024 PDF 第 4 页式 2）[1]。把拟合截距称作环境气压是错误的；本链的 POCI 仍单独取 1010。

RMW 替换从同一观测 1,305 正值，按 20-kt 风速箱（±10 kt）×纬度区间 <25/25–35/≥35° 的条件经验分布抽样；池 <20 点则依次扩到全纬度 ±15、±30 kt、最后全体，SHA256(风暴 ID、节点号、固定种子 20261014) 固定抽取。四变体共用每个风暴的同一位置与时序；STORM 亦同样替换作对照。注意：逐节点独立抽取会令 RMW 沿轨非物理跳变，因而 RMW 效应（尤其外围/弱风和 p99）**仅作探索，可能受跳变放大，不能据此冻结修正参数**。这不是作者规定的抽样口径，而是显式诊断假设；合理范围待做事件内相关保持与条件池宽度敏感性。[3][4]

事件选择为 `SHA256(事件) mod 20 <1` 的确定性约 5% 样本（RAFT 738、STORM 1,613 条，合计 2,351）。每目录使用同一组被选事件四变体配对；19 站各有同数单场峰值，包括 300 km 截断造成的 0。旧 0.5% 小样结果保留在，本报告用扩大样本；扩大是在发现单站正风样本过少后进行，并非预注册统计检验，p99 仍仅描述。对新增 5% 样本 2,351 个事件×19 站基线对照原封存主链，44,669 条站点峰值最大绝对差 0.00000334 m/s，故这确实是同一 H08 链，不是近似解析替代。[5]
